title: AGM – Plant Operations (Crusher, RMC & Concrete Block Factory)
description:
Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented Assistant General Manager (AGM) to oversee the overall operations of our Crusher, Ready-Mix Concrete (RMC) plants, and Concrete Block Factory. The candidate will be responsible for production planning, operational efficiency, quality control, maintenance coordination, cost management, safety compliance, and team leadership to achieve production and business targets.

Key Responsibilities

* Oversee day-to-day operations of crusher units, RMC plants, and concrete block manufacturing facilities.
* Plan and monitor production, dispatch, material consumption, and operational targets.
* Ensure product quality, consistency, and adherence to applicable industry standards.
* Monitor raw material procurement, stock levels, wastage, and inventory management.
* Control operational costs, improve productivity, and optimize resource utilization.
* Coordinate preventive maintenance and breakdown management of plant machinery, equipment, and vehicles.
* Ensure compliance with safety procedures, environmental requirements, and statutory regulations.
* Lead plant managers, production teams, maintenance personnel, quality teams, and other operational staff.
* Monitor plant performance, production reports, equipment downtime, and key operational KPIs.
* Coordinate with Sales, Marketing, Purchase, Accounts, HR, and Logistics teams for smooth operations.
* Resolve operational issues, customer complaints, and production or dispatch delays.
* Implement process improvements to increase efficiency, reduce wastage, and improve profitability.
* Prepare regular operational reports and present performance updates to senior management.
* Ensure timely execution of customer orders while maintaining quality and delivery commitments.

Qualifications & Experience

* BE/B.Tech or Diploma in Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, or a relevant engineering discipline.
* 10–15 years of experience in industrial operations, preferably in RMC, crusher, aggregates, or concrete block manufacturing.
* Prior experience managing multiple plants or production units is highly preferred.
* Strong knowledge of production planning, plant maintenance, quality control, cost management, and industrial safety.

Required Skills

* Strong leadership and team management.
* Production planning and operational control.
* Cost optimization and productivity improvement.
* Problem-solving and decision-making.
* MIS reporting and performance monitoring.
* Effective coordination with cross-functional teams.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Production targets and plant utilization.
* Product quality and customer satisfaction.
* Operational cost and profitability.
* Equipment uptime and maintenance efficiency.
* Material wastage and inventory control.
* Safety compliance and timely order fulfilment.

**Job Type:** Full-time  
**Experience:** 10–15 years preferred  
**Reporting To:** Senior General Manager / Management

Pay: ₹80,000.00 - ₹150,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Health insurance
* Life insurance

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Bengaluru, Karnataka 560072

title: Vice President - Software Engineering
description:
**Job Summary**

The Vice President - Software Engineering is responsible for leading the design, development, delivery, and continuous evolution of the MADTECH.AI platform. This role provides strategic and technical leadership to multiple engineering teams responsible for building scalable, secure, cloud-native B2B SaaS products.

The ideal candidate is an accomplished engineering leader with deep expertise in software architecture, cloud platforms, AI-enabled applications, data engineering, DevOps, and modern engineering practices. This individual will build high-performing engineering teams, establish engineering excellence, drive innovation, and ensure timely delivery of high-quality products while working closely with Product Management, AI/ML, Data Engineering, QA, Customer Success, and Business leadership.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Engineering Strategy & Technology Leadership**

* Define and execute the engineering strategy aligned with the organization's business and product objectives.
* Establish engineering standards, architectural principles, coding best practices, and software development governance.
* Drive technology modernization and adoption of emerging technologies including AI, Generative AI, cloud-native platforms, and automation.
* Develop long-term technology roadmaps to ensure scalability, maintainability, and security.

**Software Engineering Leadership**

* Lead multiple engineering teams responsible for backend, frontend, platform engineering, integrations, and DevOps.
* Ensure successful delivery of high-quality software products within timelines and budget.
* Oversee software architecture, technical design, implementation, testing, deployment, and production support.
* Drive engineering productivity through Agile delivery methodologies and engineering metrics.

**Architecture & Platform Engineering**

* Provide technical leadership for scalable microservices architecture and distributed systems.
* Guide architectural decisions across cloud infrastructure, APIs, data platforms, AI services, and integrations.
* Ensure platform scalability, performance, availability, reliability, and security.
* Lead architecture reviews and technology evaluations.

**Engineering Operations & Delivery Excellence**

* Improve engineering processes, SDLC, CI/CD pipelines, release management, and deployment automation.
* Implement DevSecOps best practices.
* Monitor engineering KPIs including
* Velocity
* Quality
* Reliability
* Deployment frequency
* MTTR
* Engineering efficiency
* Ensure operational excellence through observability, monitoring, incident management, and root cause analysis.

**AI & Data Engineering Enablement**

* Collaborate with AI/ML teams to integrate intelligent capabilities into the platform.
* Enable scalable data pipelines, APIs, AI agents, RAG architectures, and GenAI applications.
* Promote engineering practices that support analytics, automation, and customer intelligence.

**Cross-functional Collaboration**

* Partner closely with Product Management to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
* Collaborate with QA, Security, DevOps, Customer Success, Sales Engineering, and Product teams throughout the product lifecycle.
* Support customer escalations requiring engineering leadership.

**People Leadership**

* Recruit, mentor, coach, and retain world-class engineering talent.
* Build a culture of ownership, innovation, collaboration, accountability, and continuous learning.
* Develop engineering managers and technical leads.
* Drive performance management, succession planning, and career development.

**Technical Expertise**

* Strong expertise in designing and developing scalable, secure, cloud-native B2B SaaS applications using modern software engineering principles and best practices.
* Deep understanding of software architecture, including microservices, distributed systems, event-driven architecture, API-first design, and multi-tenant platforms.
* Proficiency in cloud platforms, with hands-on experience in AWS (mandatory); exposure to Azure and GCP is preferred. Strong knowledge of containerization technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes, Amazon EKS, and modern CI/CD pipelines.
* Extensive experience with modern software development technologies and frameworks such as Java, Python, Node.js, React, Angular, TypeScript, and related technologies.
* Strong understanding of AI/ML and Generative AI technologies, including AI Agents, LangChain, LangGraph, RAG architectures, MCP (Model Context Protocol), TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, and LLM integrations.
* Experience with data engineering, including SQL, data warehousing, ETL/ELT, reverse ETL, data modeling, data lakes, and large-scale data processing frameworks.
* Strong knowledge of RESTful APIs, GraphQL, event-driven architectures, Kafka, webhooks, third-party integrations, and modern integration frameworks.
* Experience implementing DevSecOps practices, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/CloudFormation), automated testing, release management, monitoring, logging, observability, and production support.
* Expertise in Agile software development methodologies, including Scrum, Kanban, Jira, engineering planning, sprint execution, and continuous delivery.
* Strong understanding of software quality engineering, secure coding practices, performance optimization, scalability, reliability engineering, and engineering governance.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline. Master's degree preferred.
* 15+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 8 years leading large engineering teams.
* Proven experience delivering enterprise-scale B2B SaaS products.
* Strong hands-on background in software architecture, cloud platforms, distributed systems, APIs, and modern application development.
* Experience leading engineering organizations of 30+ engineers across multiple functional teams.
* Strong understanding of AI/ML technologies, cloud-native applications, and modern software engineering practices.
* Experience working with global customers across the US, UK, Australia, and MENA markets.
* Demonstrated success in building high-performing engineering organizations.
* Excellent leadership, communication, stakeholder management, and decision-making skills.
* Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth technology environment.
* Willing to work from Mysuru or Bengaluru.

**Why MADTECH.AI?**

Join us in building the future of AI-powered Marketing Decision Intelligence.

At MADTECH.AI, we're developing a next-generation B2B SaaS platform that brings together AI, advanced analytics, cloud technologies, and intelligent automation to help organizations make faster, smarter, and data-driven business decisions.

As the VP – Software Engineering, you will have the opportunity to shape the technical vision of our platform, lead high-performing engineering teams, and influence the architecture of products used by global customers. You'll work on cutting-edge technologies, solve complex engineering challenges, and foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and engineering excellence.

If you're passionate about building scalable SaaS products, mentoring exceptional engineering talent, and making a meaningful impact in a fast-growing AI company, MADTECH.AI offers the opportunity to innovate, lead, and grow with us.

title: Lead Generation Specialist
description:
**Company:** 3DTRIX PVT LTD  
**Location:** Vijaya Bank Layout, Off Bannerghatta Road, Bangalore  
**Job Type:** Full-Time, Permanent  
**Work Mode:** Work From Office (Mandatory)  
**Shift:** 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM or 10:00 AM – 7:00 PM  
**Experience:** 1–4 Years (Freshers Not Eligible)  
**Benefits:** Health Insurance, Provident Fund (PF)

About 3DTRIX

3DTRIX PVT LTD is a Bangalore-based creative production company with around 10 years of experience and 800+ clients across 10+ countries.

We specialise in video production, including explainer videos, corporate videos, educational videos, commercial videos, interactive videos, and anamorphic videos, along with CGI, 3D product modelling, AR/VR, and Metaverse experiences.

We work with brands across manufacturing, e-commerce, IT, technology, and event management industries.

Job Description

We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented **Lead Generation Executive** to identify and generate qualified B2B leads, primarily from manufacturing companies across India and international markets.

The ideal candidate should have experience in lead research, prospect database building, email marketing, LinkedIn outreach, and lead qualification.

You will research companies participating in exhibitions and trade shows, identify businesses launching new products, collect verified decision-maker contact details, and execute personalised outreach campaigns.

Qualified leads will be handed over to our Sales and Business Development team.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Lead Research and Prospecting**

* Identify manufacturers and businesses participating in upcoming exhibitions, trade shows, and expos.
* Research companies planning or recently announcing new product launches.
* Find and verify business email addresses of relevant decision-makers.
* Identify contacts such as CMOs, Marketing Directors, VP Marketing, Heads of Marketing, Product Marketing Managers, Digital Marketing Managers, and Business Development Managers.
* Build and maintain prospect databases based on industry, location, company size, and designation.

**2. Email Marketing and LinkedIn Outreach**

* Execute personalised B2B email campaigns using company-provided outreach and automation tools.
* Customise emails based on the prospect's industry, job role, business needs, product launches, and exhibition participation.
* Conduct LinkedIn outreach to connect with relevant decision-makers.
* Follow company messaging guidelines and responsible outreach practices.

**3. Lead Qualification and CRM Management**

* Track email responses, interested prospects, and campaign performance.
* Identify and qualify potential business opportunities.
* Hand over high-potential leads to the Sales and Business Development team.
* Maintain accurate lead records, contact details, and campaign status in CRM systems and spreadsheets.
* Share qualified lead information and relevant prospect details with the Growth Lead.

**4. Database Management and Reporting**

* Maintain accurate, organised, and updated prospect databases.
* Review lead databases regularly to remove duplicates and invalid email addresses.
* Prepare daily lead generation and email campaign performance reports.
* Track lead generation activities and maintain data quality.
* Ensure responsible handling of business contact information.

**5. Service and Industry Knowledge**

* Understand the company's video production, CGI, 3D modelling, AR/VR, and related creative services.
* Research target industries and understand potential customer requirements.
* Identify relevant business opportunities based on industry-specific needs.

Performance Targets (KPIs)

* **Verified Business Email Contacts:** 1,000 per day.
* **Qualified Leads:** Minimum 2 high-potential leads per day.
* **Daily Reporting:** Submit lead generation and email campaign performance reports every working day.
* **Database Maintenance:** Review and update prospect databases weekly.

Skills and Qualifications

* 1–4 years of experience in B2B lead generation, email marketing, prospect research, or business development support.
* Strong online research and data collection skills.
* Experience in B2B email outreach and lead generation campaigns.
* Familiarity with LinkedIn prospecting and outreach.
* Good written English communication skills.
* Ability to write professional and personalised business emails.
* Knowledge of Microsoft Outlook, Excel, Google Sheets, CRM platforms, and B2B databases.
* Understanding of lead qualification, prospect segmentation, and database management.
* Strong attention to detail, organisational skills, and time management.
* Ability to manage high-volume prospecting activities while maintaining data accuracy.

**Freshers are not eligible for this position.**

**Lead Generation Tools**

Candidates with experience using any of the following platforms will have an advantage:

* LinkedIn
* Apollo.io
* Lusha
* Snov.io
* Hunter.io
* GetProspect
* Clearbit
* Crunchbase
* Kompass
* FullEnrich
* CRM and email automation tools

Relevant lead generation and outreach tools will be provided by the company.

**Benefits**

* Health Insurance
* Provident Fund (PF)
* Opportunity to work with Indian and international B2B clients
* Exposure to manufacturing, e-commerce, technology, and creative production industries
* Career growth opportunities in Sales, Business Development, and Marketing

**Career Growth**

Strong performers will have opportunities to advance into the following roles:

* Sales Executive
* Business Development Executive
* Marketing Executive

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: ₹15,000.00 - ₹50,000.00 per month

Experience:

* total work: 1 year (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

title: Analyst, Tier 1
description:
**About Kaseya**

Kaseya is the leading provider of AI-powered IT management and cybersecurity software, serving Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and internal IT organizations worldwide. Our comprehensive platform helps organizations efficiently manage, secure, and automate their IT environments, driving operational efficiency and long-term business success.

Backed by Insight Partners, a leading global software investor, Kaseya has experienced sustained double-digit growth and continues to expand its global footprint. Today, Kaseya supports customers in more than 20 countries and manages over 15 million endpoints worldwide.

Founded in 2000, Kaseya was built by builders - and we're still building. We look for people who create rather than wait, who see a hard problem and lean in, and who treat challenges as raw material. At Kaseya, everyone plays a role in shaping the future of IT: whether you're in engineering, product, sales, marketing, customer support, or operations, your work helps protect, defend, and optimize IT environments across the globe.

We're building teams that grow, perform, and make an impact. If you're driven by the itch to make things better - a product, a process, a career - you'll fit right in.

At Kaseya, we don't just raise the bar. *We build it.*

We are seeking a proactive and customer-focused NOC Support Engineer to monitor, troubleshoot, and support Windows-based infrastructure, servers, workstations, applications, and network environments across managed customer environments. This role is responsible for incident ownership from identification through resolution, ensuring adherence to SLAs, escalation procedures, and best operational practices. The ideal candidate will have strong troubleshooting skills, experience in managed services or NOC environments, and the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, customer-centric support organization.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Monitor and support servers, workstations, applications, and network devices across customer environments.
* Own endpoint alerts and incidents from initial verification through troubleshooting, resolution, escalation, and closure.
* Diagnose and resolve Windows operating system, networking, patching, backup, replication, performance, and application-related issues.
* Analyze event logs, system logs, crash dumps, and application logs to determine root causes and implement corrective actions.
* Prioritize, manage, and escalate incidents based on business impact while ensuring SLA compliance.
* Follow established SOPs, runbooks, ITIL processes, and escalation procedures across multiple customer environments.
* Maintain accurate incident records, RCA documentation, and knowledge base articles.
* Collaborate with Technical Leads and Managers to resolve complex technical issues and improve operational efficiency.

**Required Qualifications**

* 4–6 years of experience in NOC, technical support, systems administration, or remote Windows infrastructure management.
* Strong knowledge of Windows Server, Active Directory, networking fundamentals, and Microsoft ecosystem technologies.
* Hands-on experience troubleshooting authentication, Group Policy (GPO), Windows patching, replication, backup, performance, operating system, and service-related issues.
* Strong understanding of ITIL processes, incident management, SLAs, escalation management, and operational support procedures.
* Experience using remote monitoring and management (RMM) tools, preferably Kaseya solutions.
* Excellent troubleshooting, root cause analysis, technical documentation, and customer communication skills.
* Willingness to work night shifts and weekend schedules as required by business needs.
* Ability to work 100% onsite from Bengaluru, India.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working in Managed Service Provider (MSP) or enterprise NOC environments.
* Familiarity with Kaseya platforms such as VSA, BMS, IT Glue, or related monitoring and automation tools.
* Experience supporting multi-customer environments with competing priorities and incident queues.
* Knowledge of backup and disaster recovery solutions.
* Strong analytical mindset with the ability to independently manage multiple concurrent incidents.
* Demonstrated commitment to continuous learning, process improvement, and knowledge sharing.
* Professional customer service orientation with excellent written and verbal communication skills.

**Additional information**  
*Kaseya provides equal employment opportunity to all employees and applicants without regard to race, religion, age, ancestry, gender, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.*

title: Technical Service Manager, Household Care, Starch, Oils & Fats
description:
**Interested in a career that matters?**




**Interested in a career that matters?**
----------------------------------------

  

Are you passionate about using science, technical expertise and people leadership to create meaningful value for customers and contribute to a more sustainable future?

At Novonesis, we believe in the power of biology to transform industries and help build better lives. Together with our customers and partners, we combine innovative thinking and passion for science to make everyday products and industrial processes more sustainable.

We are looking for a **Technical Service Manager, Household Care, Starch, Oils & Fats** to lead our Technical Service function across South Asia. You will develop a high-performing, customer-focused technical team and help translate customer needs, industry trends and biological innovation into differentiated solutions and sustainable business growth.

  

**The Role & Your Impact**
--------------------------

As Technical Service Manager, you will lead the Technical Service agenda for Household Care, Starch, Oils & Fats across South Asia. Your role combines people leadership, technical excellence, customer engagement and strategic business contribution.

Working closely with Sales, Marketing, Technical Service & Innovation and regional and global teams, you will ensure that customers receive high-quality and timely technical solutions while strengthening our position as a trusted technical partner.

Your key responsibilities will include:

* **Lead and develop a high-performing Technical Service team** , coaching and empowering team members, strengthening technical capabilities and creating a culture of collaboration, accountability, continuous learning and safety.
* **Drive customer and technical excellence** by ensuring high-quality, timely and impactful technical solutions, application support and professional technical communication that strengthen our Trusted Advisor position with customers.
* **Contribute to industry and business leadership** by co-leading relevant industry groups and partnering with Sales and Marketing to connect customer and industry needs with differentiated technical solutions, value propositions, pipeline opportunities and regional growth priorities.
* **Accelerate innovation and successful launches** by collaborating with Technical Service & Innovation and regional and global technical networks to bring new products, tools, services and relevant global capabilities to customers in South Asia.
* **Strengthen technical partnerships and networks** by working with internal and external experts, technical institutes and partners to expand knowledge, capabilities and access to expertise.
* **Optimise resources, infrastructure and budgets** in line with customer and business priorities, identifying capability and investment needs while ensuring responsible utilisation of internal and external technical resources.

Success in this role will be reflected through tangible business and customer impact, high standards of technical execution, successful innovation and launches, the continued development of team capabilities, and effective management of resources, safety and compliance.

  

**What You’ll Need to Be Successful**
-------------------------------------

To succeed in this role, you will bring:

* A **PhD, M.Sc. or B.Sc.** in biological sciences, chemistry, chemical engineering or another relevant scientific or technical discipline.
* At least **five years of relevant professional experience** , together with demonstrated success in leading projects or teams.
* Strong scientific and technical expertise, with the ability to understand applications, processes and customer technical challenges.
* Proven people-leadership capabilities, including coaching, team development and technical capability building.
* Strong customer and commercial acumen, with the ability to translate technical solutions into clear customer and business value.
* Strategic and analytical thinking, with the ability to connect industry trends, customer needs and technical capabilities to business opportunities.
* Strong collaboration and influencing skills, including the ability to work effectively across Sales, Marketing, Technical Service & Innovation, laboratory teams and regional and global functions.
Strong technical communication, presentation and customer-engagement skills.  

  

**Additional Skills & Interests We Value**
------------------------------------------

It would be an advantage if you bring:

* Experience within **Household Care or another PHB-relevant industrial segment** .
* Experience working in a regional or international technical environment.
* Experience contributing to product, application, tool or service launches.
* Experience collaborating with external technical institutes, experts or industry partners.
A strong interest in combining technical excellence, customer insight and innovation to create sustainable business growth.  

  

**What We Offer**
-----------------

This is an opportunity to lead a strategically important Technical Service function and shape how biological innovation creates value for customers across South Asia.

You will work at the intersection of science, customer needs and business growth while leading and developing a talented technical team. You will collaborate closely with commercial, marketing, innovation, laboratory and global technical colleagues, giving you the opportunity to broaden your impact, strengthen capabilities and bring relevant global expertise to customers in the region.

You will be part of a purpose-driven environment where scientific expertise, collaboration and continuous learning help turn the power of biology into solutions that benefit customers, society and the planet.

  

**Ways of Working / Working Conditions**
----------------------------------------

This is an **office-first position based in Bangalore** .

The role requires close collaboration with customers, partners and Novonesis colleagues across South Asia as well as regional and global technical teams.

**Travel of approximately 35%** is expected to support customers and business priorities.

  

**Relevant Information**
------------------------

**Application deadline:** 10 November

**Hiring manager:** Puneeth Kumar K T, Commercial Director, PHB South Asia

**Contact:** PKKT@Novonesis.com

**Our purpose guides the way**

In Novonesis, we know that solutions rooted in biology can help solve humanity’s biggest challenges. Since we began more than a century ago, this has been our guide. It’s how we've gotten so far. And it’s how we'll impact the future. Now, more than ever, the world needs change. And with biosolutions, the possibilities for transformation are endless. If our purpose resonates with you, we encourage you to apply.

**Opportunities for everyone**

We are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunity for all applicants. Therefore we ask you to apply without a cover letter or photo and instead include a few sentences in your CV explaining your motivation for applying.

We make all employment decisions based on business needs and welcome candidates with a wide range of backgrounds, including ethnicity, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, or veteran status.

**Explore other openings**

If this position isn’t the right fit, you may still find other opportunities with us. You’re welcome to explore open roles or create a job agent to stay connected with future opportunities at novonesis.com/Career

The initial and largest focus will be our global public web ecosystem, where the opportunity to improve operational consistency, scalability and performance is greatest. The broader mandate extends across the owned digital channels and platforms managed by Digital Marketing. You will help establish common workflows, standards and operating practices so content can be created, approved, published, distributed, measured and optimized consistently—regardless of platform or destination.

You will work as an integral member of a global Enterprise Digital organization, partnering with Marketing, Content, Digital Product, UX/UI, Technology, Analytics, SEO, Accessibility, Compliance and business teams.

**Major Duties:**

**Digital workflow and process excellence**
-------------------------------------------

* Own and continuously improve workflows spanning intake, requirements, prioritization, production, approvals, publishing/distribution, QA, measurement and optimization.
* Map current-state processes and identify bottlenecks, unnecessary handoffs, duplication, control gaps and sources of rework.
* Create and maintain SOPs, workflow documentation, checklists, service expectations, decision criteria and escalation paths.
* Use operational data to improve cycle time, throughput, quality and predictability.
* Identify opportunities to simplify work through process redesign, automation and platform integration.

**Owned digital publishing and delivery**
-----------------------------------------

* Independently manage complex digital requests and releases from intake through post-launch validation.
* Author, maintain and publish content in Adobe Experience Manager or a comparable enterprise CMS.
* Support enterprise websites, landing pages, insights and thought-leadership experiences, product and solution content, localized experiences and other owned digital destinations.
* Manage content and asset requirements including metadata, taxonomy, tagging, approvals, localization and lifecycle.
* Promote approved templates, reusable components and structured-content practices that enable scale.

**Standards, governance and risk reduction**
--------------------------------------------

* Help define, document, operationalize and maintain digital publishing and delivery standards.
* Translate UX, design-system, accessibility, SEO, analytics, content, privacy, compliance and technology requirements into practical procedures.
* Establish and apply QA and release-readiness practices.
* Identify inconsistent practices, unnecessary customization and workarounds that create operational risk, technical debt or fragmented experiences.
* Coordinate exceptions with the appropriate Product, Technology, Design or control owner.

**Quality and experience assurance**
------------------------------------

* Perform and improve pre- and post-publication QA.
* Validate content accuracy, page structure, responsive behavior, links, imagery, documents, metadata, accessibility, SEO, analytics and experience requirements.
* Coordinate defect remediation and support regression testing and production validation.
* Analyze recurring defects to identify root causes and preventive improvements.

**Performance and optimization**
--------------------------------

* Partner with Analytics, SEO, UX and Digital Product teams to understand operational, site-health and experience performance.
* Translate insight into prioritized opportunities that improve discoverability, accessibility, usability, engagement and conversion where applicable.
* Support audits, testing and experimentation; validate whether changes deliver the intended result.
* Create a closed loop from publish to measure, learn, optimize and standardize.

**Automation, integration and productivity**
--------------------------------------------

* Identify repetitive tasks and workflow bottlenecks suitable for automation.
* Translate operational problems into requirements for Product, MarTech and Technology teams.
* Support integrations connecting work management, CMS, DAM, analytics and related platforms.
* Participate in implementation, testing, adoption and benefits measurement for workflow and platform enhancements.
* Evaluate responsible AI-enabled improvements where they solve a defined operational problem and preserve quality and controls.

**Cross-functional partnership and enablement**
-----------------------------------------------

* Serve as an operational bridge between business requirements and digital execution.
* Coordinate dependencies across Marketing, Content, Product, UX/UI, Technology, Analytics, SEO, Accessibility and control teams.
* Explain standards, platform constraints and operating requirements in clear business terms.
* Support onboarding, training and change adoption for publishers, contributors and stakeholders.
* Surface systemic problems and improvement opportunities to Digital leadership.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience in Digital Marketing, Marketing Technology, Information Systems, Business, Communications or a related discipline.
* 5+ years of relevant experience in digital operations, web operations, digital production, content operations, marketing operations or digital-experience delivery.
* Hands-on experience with enterprise websites, content-management platforms or complex digital ecosystems; Adobe Experience Manager strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated experience owning or improving end-to-end digital workflows.
* Experience developing or improving SOPs, governance practices, QA standards or operational controls.
* Experience coordinating complex work across business and technical stakeholders.
* Working knowledge of accessibility, SEO, analytics, UX, content lifecycle and web-performance fundamentals.
* Experience using operational or performance data to identify problems and improve outcomes.
* Strong prioritization, documentation, facilitation, problem-solving and communication skills.
* Ability to work independently in a global, matrixed organization.

**Preferred**

* Adobe Experience Manager Sites and Assets; Adobe Workfront or a comparable work-management platform.
* Adobe Analytics and/or Google Analytics 4.
* Global, multilingual or multisite content operations; localization, translation or MSM experience.
* WCAG accessibility, technical/on-page SEO and Core Web Vitals knowledge.
* Workflow automation, systems integration, structured-content or content-supply-chain experience.
* Agile delivery, experimentation, personalization or conversion-optimization exposure.
* Financial services or another regulated enterprise environment.

**Working with Us**

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.

  

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.

  

**Reasonable Accommodation**

Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.

  
  

**About Our Bangalore Office**

The Northern Trust Bangalore office, established in 2005, is home to over 5,600 employees. In this stunning office space, we offer fantastic amenities which include our Arrival Hub - Jungle, the GameZone, and the Employee Experience Zone that appeal to both clients and employees. Learn more.

title: Product Marketing & Content Executive
description:
**Company:** Factori.ai

**Department:** Marketing

**Location:** Bangalore, HSR Layout

**Work Mode:** 5 Days Work From Office

  

**About Factori**

Factori is the real-world data layer for enterprise AI. Our real-world intelligence platform connects business decisions and AI systems to aggregated physical-world signals through the Real World Graph. We help enterprise teams bring external context into decisions about locations, markets and customers. Our marketing team is building awareness and qualified demand among multi-location retailers and QSR businesses, starting with the US market.

  

**The Role**

  

We are looking for a hands-on marketer who combines product marketing with strong content creation skills. You will help retail buyers understand what Factori does, why it matters and how our insights solve real business problems. Working closely with the Product Marketing Lead and Growth Lead, you will develop product messaging, sales enablement materials, customer stories, thought leadership and digital content. You will translate complex data and product capabilities into clear, credible and engaging narratives that educate buyers, strengthen Factori’s positioning and support marketing and sales efforts.

  

This is an individual contributor role with equal ownership across product marketing and content marketing.

  

**What You Will Own**

  

**A. Product Marketing (50%)**

* Buyer and Market Research: Research retail buying situations, including expansion, site selection, competitor evaluation and local marketing. Gather insights from customer interviews, sales conversations and market research to understand buyer needs and pain points.
* Product Positioning and Messaging: Translate Factori’s capabilities, including aggregated mobility signals, points of interest, APIs and MCP, into clear business value propositions for retail expansion leaders, marketers and analysts.
* Sales Enablement: Create solution briefs, one-pagers, sales decks, demo scripts, FAQs, objection-handling documents and competitive comparison materials to help sales teams communicate Factori’s value.
* Customer Stories and Use Cases: Work with product, data and customer-facing teams to develop evidence-based customer stories, use cases and original-data narratives. Clearly document sources, assumptions and limitations.
* Product Launches: Coordinate messaging and launch assets for confirmed product capabilities, including announcements, demos, FAQs and sales enablement materials. Ensure all communication reflects actual product availability.
* Feedback and Optimization: Gather feedback from sales, customers and marketing campaigns to refine messaging, strengthen positioning and improve the effectiveness of sales materials.

**B. Content Marketing (50%)**

* Content Strategy and Planning: Develop and execute a content calendar aligned with Factori’s marketing priorities, target retail audiences, product narratives and business objectives.
* Long-Form Content Creation: Write high-quality blogs, articles, industry explainers, thought leadership pieces, reports and other educational content focused on retail intelligence, location analytics, consumer behaviour and AI-driven business decisions.
* SEO-Focused Content: Create search-friendly content around relevant keywords, customer questions and industry topics. Collaborate with SEO and web specialists to improve content discoverability and organic visibility.
* Thought Leadership: Turn Factori’s insights, research and expertise into compelling content for executive LinkedIn posts, company updates, newsletters and other relevant channels.
* Content Repurposing: Adapt original research, customer stories and product insights into multiple formats, including blogs, social posts, email content, webinar materials, infographics and sales collateral.
* Editorial Quality: Maintain high standards for writing, structure, clarity, factual accuracy, tone and consistency across all content. Work with subject-matter experts to validate technical and business claims.
* Content Performance: Track relevant metrics such as organic traffic, engagement, content-assisted conversions and asset usage. Use performance data and audience feedback to improve future content.

**Required AI Knowledge and Skills**

  

Practical knowledge of using AI to design, execute and improve product marketing and content workflows is required.

* Proficiency with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude or equivalents for research synthesis, content development, messaging, ideation and sales enablement.
* Ability to use AI to accelerate content production while maintaining originality, factual accuracy, brand consistency and appropriate human review.
* Understanding of prompt design, context grounding and source verification, including validating claims against approved product documentation, customer evidence and reliable sources.
* Ability to build repeatable AI-assisted workflows with clear inputs, review steps and quality checks.
* Awareness of responsible handling of confidential information, copyright considerations and the limitations of AI-generated content.

**What You Bring**

* Experience in product marketing, content marketing, B2B writing or a related role, with work samples demonstrating your individual contribution.
* Strong writing, editing and storytelling skills, with the ability to simplify complex technical concepts for business audiences.
* Experience creating multiple content formats, such as blogs, articles, thought leadership, case studies, product collateral or sales enablement materials.
* Understanding of product positioning, buyer personas, value propositions and how content supports the customer journey.
* Familiarity with SEO fundamentals, keyword research, content optimization and content performance metrics.
* Practical experience using AI in repeatable workflows, including fact-checking, source verification and improving output quality.
* Strong collaboration and project management skills, with the ability to work across product, sales, data and marketing teams.
* Comfort working with spreadsheets, charts and basic performance reports, and the ability to distinguish verified findings from assumptions.

Experience with B2B SaaS, enterprise technology, retail technology, data products, geospatial intelligence or AI-driven solutions is useful but not mandatory.

  

**What Success Looks Like**

  

In your first 90 days, you will understand Factori’s priority retail buyers, establish a strong foundation of approved messaging and content themes, and deliver a coordinated set of product marketing and content assets. Success will be measured through the quality and accuracy of messaging, adoption of sales enablement materials, consistency and effectiveness of content production, organic visibility, audience engagement and contribution to qualified marketing engagement and sales conversations.

  

**Why Join Factori?**

  

Your work will shape how enterprise buyers understand Factori and its real-world intelligence platform. You will work with experienced marketing leaders, explore practical applications of AI in marketing and build content and messaging that help a growing business reach the right audiences.

This is a role for someone who enjoys bringing order to complexity, connecting people and making things happen.

You will work closely with the CEO on projects spanning digital marketing, content strategy, social media, brand building and broader business initiatives. You will coordinate with stakeholders across teams, translate discussions into actionable plans, track progress, resolve bottlenecks and ensure that priorities move forward.

You are not expected to be the subject-matter expert in every function. You are expected to understand the work, ask the right questions, coordinate the right people and ensure that commitments turn into outcomes.

### **Key Responsibilities**

**1. Project Management & Execution**

* Convert ideas, discussions and strategic priorities into clear project plans with defined deliverables, owners and deadlines.
* Maintain project trackers, monitor milestones and proactively follow up with stakeholders.
* Identify dependencies, delays and bottlenecks, and work with the relevant teams to resolve them.
* Ensure that decisions made in meetings translate into documented action items and completed tasks.
* Provide regular updates to the CEO on project progress, priorities, risks and pending decisions.
* Manage multiple initiatives simultaneously while ensuring that important priorities do not fall through the cracks.

**2. Digital Marketing, Content & Social Media**

* Coordinate the execution of marketing and content plans across Toehold's brands and the CEO's personal brand.
* Work with content creators, designers, video editors, social media managers and digital marketing teams to ensure timely delivery.
* Track content calendars, campaign schedules, creative approvals and publishing commitments.
* Coordinate digital marketing initiatives, including campaign execution, lead generation and performance reporting.
* Help translate content and marketing strategies into briefs, assignments and actionable workflows.
* Monitor key performance indicators and ensure that insights and recommendations are followed through.

**3. Cross-functional Coordination**

* Act as a coordination point between the CEO and relevant internal teams, ensuring clarity on priorities and expectations.
* Liaise with marketing, creative, technology, sales, operations and other stakeholders as required.
* Ensure that team members understand their responsibilities, timelines and dependencies.
* Follow up firmly but professionally to maintain accountability and momentum.
* Facilitate collaboration between teams and help resolve execution gaps.
* Escalate issues that require the CEO's attention, along with context and potential solutions.

**4. CEO's Office & Executive Support**

* Help the CEO organise priorities, manage action items and maintain visibility over ongoing initiatives.
* Prepare meeting agendas, capture decisions and circulate concise follow-up notes.
* Organise information, briefs, presentations and reports to support decision-making.
* Research topics, evaluate options and prepare preliminary recommendations when required.
* Anticipate upcoming requirements and ensure that the CEO has the information and preparation needed for important discussions.
* Handle sensitive business information with discretion and professionalism.

**5. Process Improvement & Operational Efficiency**

* Identify recurring execution gaps and introduce simple, effective systems to address them.
* Establish and maintain workflows, documentation and reporting mechanisms.
* Use project management, collaboration and AI tools to improve productivity and reduce manual follow-ups.
* Continuously look for ways to improve coordination, communication and execution across the organisation.

### **Who We Are Looking For**

We are looking for someone who combines strong organisational skills with an understanding of marketing and a genuine bias for action.

You may come from project management, digital marketing, content operations, an agency environment, a founder's office or a similar role where you have coordinated people and projects across functions.

**Essential skills and attributes**

* Strong project management, planning and organisational skills.
* A working understanding of digital marketing, content marketing and social media.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* The ability to coordinate multiple stakeholders and follow through on commitments.
* Strong attention to detail without losing sight of the bigger picture.
* Comfort working with ambiguity, shifting priorities and tight timelines.
* The ability to work independently, exercise sound judgement and know when to escalate.
* A proactive mindset: you identify what needs to happen rather than wait to be told every next step.
* Professionalism, discretion and the ability to work closely with the CEO.

### **Experience & Qualifications**

* Approximately 3–7 years of relevant professional experience in project management, marketing operations, content operations, executive support or a related field.
* Demonstrable experience coordinating projects involving multiple stakeholders.
* Practical familiarity with social media workflows, content calendars and digital marketing campaigns.
* Proficiency with productivity and collaboration tools such as Notion, Google Workspace, spreadsheets and project management platforms.
* Familiarity with AI tools for research, documentation, planning and workflow automation is an advantage.

Relevant experience and demonstrated execution ability matter more than a specific degree.

### **What Success Looks Like**

In this role, success means:

* Projects move forward consistently, with clear ownership and fewer missed deadlines.
* The CEO has better visibility into priorities, progress and roadblocks.
* Marketing and content initiatives are executed on time and to the required standard.
* Teams have clarity on what needs to be done, by whom and by when.
* Meetings lead to action, and follow-ups do not depend on the CEO remembering everything.
* Recurring problems are converted into better processes rather than repeatedly handled as exceptions.
* The CEO gains more time to focus on strategy, leadership and high-value decisions.

### **What We Offer**

* Direct exposure to the CEO and the workings of a growing travel and photography business.
* The opportunity to work across strategy, marketing, content and business operations.
* Significant ownership and scope to improve how work gets done.
* A varied role with opportunities to develop project management, marketing and leadership skills.
* A collaborative environment where initiative, accountability and thoughtful execution are valued.

### **How to Apply**

* Send us your CV along with a brief note explaining why you would be a good fit for this role. Write to careers@toehold.in
* Please also share one example of a project you helped coordinate from planning to completion. Tell us what your role was, how you handled stakeholders and what the outcome was.
* We are particularly interested in people who can demonstrate how they turn plans into results.

title: Product Marketing & Content Executive
description:
**Job Description: Product Marketing & Content Executive (1-4 years)**

**Company:** Factori.ai

**Department:** Marketing

**Location:** Bangalore, HSR Layout

**Work Mode:** 5 Days Work From Office

**About Factori**

Factori is the real-world data layer for enterprise AI. Our real-world intelligence platform connects business decisions and AI systems to aggregated physical-world signals through the Real World Graph. We help enterprise teams bring external context into decisions about locations, markets and customers. Our marketing team is building awareness and qualified demand among multi-location retailers and QSR businesses, starting with the US market.

**The Role**

We are looking for a hands-on marketer who combines product marketing with strong content creation skills. You will help retail buyers understand what Factori does, why it matters and how our insights solve real business problems. Working closely with the Product Marketing Lead and Growth Lead, you will develop product messaging, sales enablement materials, customer stories, thought leadership and digital content. You will translate complex data and product capabilities into clear, credible and engaging narratives that educate buyers, strengthen Factori’s positioning and support marketing and sales efforts.

This is an individual contributor role with equal ownership across product marketing and content marketing.

**What You Will Own**

**A. Product Marketing (50%)**

* Buyer and Market Research: Research retail buying situations, including expansion, site selection, competitor evaluation and local marketing. Gather insights from customer interviews, sales conversations and market research to understand buyer needs and pain points.
* Product Positioning and Messaging: Translate Factori’s capabilities, including aggregated mobility signals, points of interest, APIs and MCP, into clear business value propositions for retail expansion leaders, marketers and analysts.
* Sales Enablement: Create solution briefs, one-pagers, sales decks, demo scripts, FAQs, objection-handling documents and competitive comparison materials to help sales teams communicate Factori’s value.
* Customer Stories and Use Cases: Work with product, data and customer-facing teams to develop evidence-based customer stories, use cases and original-data narratives. Clearly document sources, assumptions and limitations.
* Product Launches: Coordinate messaging and launch assets for confirmed product capabilities, including announcements, demos, FAQs and sales enablement materials. Ensure all communication reflects actual product availability.
* Feedback and Optimization: Gather feedback from sales, customers and marketing campaigns to refine messaging, strengthen positioning and improve the effectiveness of sales materials.

**B. Content Marketing (50%)**

* Content Strategy and Planning: Develop and execute a content calendar aligned with Factori’s marketing priorities, target retail audiences, product narratives and business objectives.
* Long-Form Content Creation: Write high-quality blogs, articles, industry explainers, thought leadership pieces, reports and other educational content focused on retail intelligence, location analytics, consumer behaviour and AI-driven business decisions.
* SEO-Focused Content: Create search-friendly content around relevant keywords, customer questions and industry topics. Collaborate with SEO and web specialists to improve content discoverability and organic visibility.
* Thought Leadership: Turn Factori’s insights, research and expertise into compelling content for executive LinkedIn posts, company updates, newsletters and other relevant channels.
* Content Repurposing: Adapt original research, customer stories and product insights into multiple formats, including blogs, social posts, email content, webinar materials, infographics and sales collateral.
* Editorial Quality: Maintain high standards for writing, structure, clarity, factual accuracy, tone and consistency across all content. Work with subject-matter experts to validate technical and business claims.
* Content Performance: Track relevant metrics such as organic traffic, engagement, content-assisted conversions and asset usage. Use performance data and audience feedback to improve future content.

**Required AI Knowledge and Skills**

Practical knowledge of using AI to design, execute and improve product marketing and content workflows is required.

* Proficiency with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude or equivalents for research synthesis, content development, messaging, ideation and sales enablement.
* Ability to use AI to accelerate content production while maintaining originality, factual accuracy, brand consistency and appropriate human review.
* Understanding of prompt design, context grounding and source verification, including validating claims against approved product documentation, customer evidence and reliable sources.
* Ability to build repeatable AI-assisted workflows with clear inputs, review steps and quality checks.
* Awareness of responsible handling of confidential information, copyright considerations and the limitations of AI-generated content.

**What You Bring**

* Experience in product marketing, content marketing, B2B writing or a related role, with work samples demonstrating your individual contribution.
* Strong writing, editing and storytelling skills, with the ability to simplify complex technical concepts for business audiences.
* Experience creating multiple content formats, such as blogs, articles, thought leadership, case studies, product collateral or sales enablement materials.
* Understanding of product positioning, buyer personas, value propositions and how content supports the customer journey.
* Familiarity with SEO fundamentals, keyword research, content optimization and content performance metrics.
* Practical experience using AI in repeatable workflows, including fact-checking, source verification and improving output quality.
* Strong collaboration and project management skills, with the ability to work across product, sales, data and marketing teams.
* Comfort working with spreadsheets, charts and basic performance reports, and the ability to distinguish verified findings from assumptions.

Experience with B2B SaaS, enterprise technology, retail technology, data products, geospatial intelligence or AI-driven solutions is useful but not mandatory.

**What Success Looks Like**

In your first 90 days, you will understand Factori’s priority retail buyers, establish a strong foundation of approved messaging and content themes, and deliver a coordinated set of product marketing and content assets. Success will be measured through the quality and accuracy of messaging, adoption of sales enablement materials, consistency and effectiveness of content production, organic visibility, audience engagement and contribution to qualified marketing engagement and sales conversations.

**Why Join Factori?**

Your work will shape how enterprise buyers understand Factori and its real-world intelligence platform. You will work with experienced marketing leaders, explore practical applications of AI in marketing and build content and messaging that help a growing business reach the right audiences.

description:
**GROWTH & MARKET EXPANSION LEAD**

Build Markets. Build Brands. Build Impact.

Most sales roles ask you to execute a playbook someone else has already written.  
This role asks you to build the playbook.

B.Bindi brings products made by rural women, self-help groups, and farmer producer organisations to customers across urban India. We're looking for an ambitious, hands-on Growth & Market Expansion Lead to take BBindi to the next level — both online and offline — working directly with the founding team.

**WHAT YOU'LL BUILD**

* Retail & Distribution General Trade, Modern Trade, retail, wholesale, distributors, super-stockists, institutional sales — starting in Bengaluru, expanding to new cities. Your scoreboard: distribution, shelf visibility, revenue.
* Online & E-commerce Growth Website, product listings, online sales, traffic, conversions, social commerce. You don't need to code — you need to be comfortable running it.
* Digital Campaigns Meta & Google Ads, lead-gen and conversion campaigns. Comfortable with Reach → Clicks → Leads → Conversion → Sales → ROI.
* Full-Funnel Thinking Connect marketing to actual revenue across Awareness → Interest → Lead → Customer → Repeat Customer — not just likes and views.
* Relationships Retailers, distributors, super-stockists, institutional buyers, online platforms — trust that turns into long-term business.
* Market Intelligence Track competitors, pricing, trends — and tell us what to do about it, not just what happened.
* Test → Learn → Scale New products, formats, channels, and campaigns. Double down on what works; move fast from what doesn't.

**WHAT MAKES THIS DIFFERENT**

Real ownership — no waiting on a 12-layer hierarchy. You'll work with the founding team and influence what we sell, where we sell, how we market, and how we grow.

**WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

A Growth Builder, not just a Sales Manager. 3–7 years in Sales, Marketing, Business Development, FMCG, Retail, E-commerce, D2C, or Startups. Ideally with experience in:

Building sales channels **managing retailers/distributors**  e-commerce & website ownership **Meta Ads & digital** campaigns **lead generation**  customer acquisition **campaign & sales performance tracking**  market research The kind of person who thrives: Entrepreneurial, hands-on, commercially minded, curious, data-aware, relationship-driven, action-oriented, adaptable — someone who meets a distributor in the morning, checks online sales at noon, launches a Meta campaign in the afternoon, and comes back tomorrow with a new growth idea.

We're not looking for someone who wants to manage a territory. We're looking for someone who wants to build one.

**WHY B. BINDI?**  
B. Bindi is the market-facing wing of EMP Bindi International Association, a social enterprise creating sustainable livelihoods for rural women through entrepreneurship, renewable energy, digital education, and agri-livelihoods.

Your work here won't only create sales — it can create markets, livelihoods, and a brand with purpose.

**WHAT YOU GET**

Founder exposure  
**Real ownership**   
Multi-channel experience (retail, distribution, e-commer digital)  
**Build from the ground up**   
Freedom to experiment **Purpose + business**  
Car growth as BBindi grows

**ROLE DETAILS**:  
Designation: Growth & Market Expansion Lead |  
Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka |  
Experience: 3–7 years |  
Employment: Full-Time |  
Travel: Required |  
Languages: English & Kannada, Hindi a plus |  
Education: Graduate/Postgraduate in Marketing, Business Admin, or related — but what you've built matters more than where you studied.

**READY TO BUILD SOMETHING?**

If you want a routine 9-to-5 role with an existing playbook, this probably isn't it. If you want to build a market, a distribution network, digital sales, campaigns, a brand, and your career — we'd love to hear from you.

**Job description**
-------------------

**About this role**

The eFront Insight business, a part of Aladdin, is a fast-growing part of BlackRock’s Private Markets technology strategy, focused on building a best-in-class Private Markets Data and Analytical platform. The Insight business is a front-office platform for alternative investment professionals, creating an ecosystem connecting Limited Partners (Asset Owners / Funds of Funds), General Partners (Asset Managers), and Asset Servicers.

The Aladdin Business brings together professionals responsible for implementing and supporting our Aladdin clients, sales and marketing, and ensuring the Aladdin Community maximizes Aladdin products through engagement and education.

  
  

**Your role and impact**

We are seeking an experienced leader to play a key role in the global leadership of Private Data Services. The role spans three core areas: global operations management, client management, and artificial intelligence (AI)-led transformation.

  
  

The successful candidate will be responsible for delivering high-quality operations at scale, strengthening the client experience, managing complex service and operational escalations, and driving the evolution of the operating model. The role will also lead opportunities to apply AI, automation and process improvement to simplify workflows, strengthen controls, enhance productivity, and deliver better outcomes for clients and the business.

  
  

**Your responsibilities**

In every role at BlackRock, you'll be expected to apply sound judgement and critical thinking to solve complex problems, adapt as the business evolves, and combine the curiosity to explore new approaches and technologies with the rigor to challenge the results. The scope of this role also includes the following responsibilities:

  
  

* Provide global leadership for Private Data Services operations, with accountability for timely and high-quality delivery, effective workforce and capacity management, operational resilience and scalable operating practices.

* Lead client engagement and manage complex client escalations, partnering across client, product, technology and operations teams to drive timely resolution while identifying and addressing underlying systemic issues

* Establish strong operating discipline across service quality, productivity, controls and operational risk, using appropriate metrics and governance to continuously improve performance.

* Lead AI-enabled transformation and automation initiatives, identify opportunities to simplify workflows, reduce manual intervention, and improve the quality, efficiency and scalability of service delivery.

* Drive end-to-end process improvement and operating model transformation, translating operational challenges and client needs into sustainable solutions and measurable business outcomes.

* Build and develop a high-performing global organization by strengthening leadership capabilities, succession and talent pipelines, establishing clear accountability, and fostering an inclusive and collaborative culture.
  

  

**Your experience**

* MBA or other relevant postgraduate qualification preferred.

* 16–20 years of relevant experience in financial services, including significant leadership experience across operations, managed services, investment data, or related functions.

* Strong strategic thinking, analytical and problem-solving capabilities, combined with experience in operational governance, change management, developing high-performing teams, and communicating effectively across functions and geographies.

To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.

**Our hybrid work model**

BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.

At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.

**What you'll be doing**

Lead the E-Commerce Engineering capability across Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC/Demandware) and Shopify, owning technical execution, full-stack delivery, and operational reliability across all brand websites while building and developing a high-performing engineering team.

* Own platform technical execution and codebase governance across SFCC (Demandware) multi-brand realms and Shopify Plus applications.
* Oversee end-to-end frontend and backend code delivery using Node.js, ISML, SFRA (Storefront Reference Architecture), and modern JavaScript frameworks across all brand websites.
* Drive migration from monolithic SFCC setups toward composable, decoupled frontend microservices and API-first integrations.
* Enforce secure coding standards, peer code reviews, automated unit and integration testing, and DevSecOps practices across e-commerce squads.
* Lead multi-squad engineering delivery within two-week agile sprints and 8-week Program Increment (PI) planning cycles. Engineering Reports to Director of Engineering Bengaluru.
* Ensure peak site availability, fast page-load speeds, and zero-downtime checkouts during high-volume retail trading events.
* Oversee technical interfaces connecting e-commerce applications with middleware (MuleSoft), Order Management (Fluent OMS), POS (Oracle XStore), and payment gateways, and track DORA metrics (Deployment Frequency, Lead Time for Changes,Defect Escape Rate, MTTR).
* Manage production code deployments and implementations releases, constantly improving the process to reach a goal of multi releases per day.
* Own SFCC and Shopify platform from maintenance perspective making sure that everything is operationally working as expected without any disruptions.

title: Associate Performance Marketing Manager
description:
*1 Line JD: A hands-on growth and performance marketing role for someone who can connect media, creative, consumer behaviour, and the full funnel to find and scale the next growth lever for As-It-Is Nutrition.*

<aside>

**Our Mission**

As-It-Is Nutrition exists to make honest, effective sports nutrition accessible to every Indian household, not only serious gym-goers. We are building a trusted, mainstream nutrition brand by putting real ingredients, transparency, and results above hype.

</aside>

About As-It-Is Nutrition

As-It-Is Nutrition is a digital-first sports nutrition business with approximately ₹250 crore in revenue. We are already one of the largest brands in the category, but there is a much bigger opportunity ahead: becoming a household name for a broader set of Indian consumers.

The marketing function is evolving from a founder-led setup into a structured, high-performing team. This is an opportunity to join that journey early and help build a sharper, more repeatable growth engine.

The Role

We are looking for an **Assistant Manager, Growth and Performance Marketing** who is curious about why performance changes, not only what the dashboard reports.

You will work closely with the Head of Marketing and cross-functional creative, content, design, analytics, and commerce partners. You will manage campaigns, diagnose the full funnel, turn data into testable hypotheses, and help the team make better decisions about audiences, creatives, offers, landing pages, and budgets.

This is a hands-on role for someone with 2 to 3 years of experience who is ready to move beyond platform operations and become a strong growth problem-solver.

**You will report to:** Head of Marketing

What You Will Own1. Performance Marketing

* Manage and optimise campaigns across Meta, Google, and other relevant paid channels.
* Track performance against revenue, CAC or CPR, ROAS, conversion, and scale potential.
* Make clear recommendations on when to scale, hold, iterate, or stop a campaign or creative.
* Monitor budget allocation and identify where spend can work harder.

2. Full-Funnel Growth Diagnosis

* Read the journey from spend to audience, creative, click, landing-page view, conversion, AOV, and ROAS.
* Identify where performance is leaking and determine whether the issue sits in targeting, creative, landing page, offer, product, pricing, or checkout.
* Look beyond top-line efficiency metrics to understand what is actually driving or limiting growth.

3. Growth Opportunity Discovery

* Find under-funded audiences, inefficient segments, regional opportunities, and hidden signals in campaign and customer data.
* Investigate anomalies before changing budgets or targeting.
* Turn observations into prioritised opportunities with a clear business case.

4. Creative Performance

* Develop consumer hypotheses, messaging angles, hooks, offers, and creative briefs.
* Work closely with designers, copywriters, editors, and creators to improve ad performance.
* Connect creative learnings with audience and funnel data so each test produces a useful next step.
* Build a clear view of creative fatigue, winning angles, and refresh requirements.

5. Experimentation

* Use a disciplined process: **Observation → Hypothesis → Experiment → Metric → Decision**.
* Define what each test is expected to teach, not only what it is expected to improve.
* Maintain a learning log so successful insights can be reused across products, audiences, and channels.
* Balance testing velocity with sufficient signal and commercial relevance.

6. CRO and Funnel Improvement

* Partner with relevant teams to improve landing pages, offers, product pages, and checkout journeys.
* Diagnose gaps between clicks and landing-page views, traffic and conversion, or ROAS and AOV.
* Recommend practical changes based on evidence, then measure the impact.

Your First 90 DaysFirst 30 Days: Learn and Diagnose

* Understand the product portfolio, customer segments, growth targets, current channel mix, and performance baselines.
* Audit campaign structure, audience allocation, creative performance, landing pages, and existing reporting.
* Build a clear view of the most important funnel leaks and unanswered questions.

Days 31 to 60: Test and Improve

* Launch prioritised experiments across audience, creative, offer, and landing-page variables.
* Create a simple, reliable cadence for campaign reviews and learning documentation.
* Work with the creative team to translate data into sharper hooks, briefs, and variants.

Days 61 to 90: Scale the Learning System

* Identify repeatable growth opportunities and recommend where to scale, hold, iterate, or stop.
* Improve budget allocation using channel, audience, creative, and funnel evidence.
* Establish a working growth scorecard and a backlog of high-quality experiments.

What We Are Looking For

* 2 to 3 years of hands-on performance or growth marketing experience.
* Strong practical knowledge of Meta Ads and experience managing real budgets.
* Working knowledge of Google Ads and other relevant acquisition channels.
* Strong understanding of ROAS, CAC or CPR, AOV, CTR, CPC, CPM, landing-page view rate, CVR, frequency, and creative fatigue.
* Ability to turn numbers into questions, hypotheses, and decisions, not only dashboards.
* Creative thinking and the ability to identify multiple consumer and messaging angles for the same product.
* Comfort writing or shaping ad concepts, hooks, and briefs.
* Strong Excel or Google Sheets and analytics skills. GA4 experience is preferred.
* D2C or e-commerce experience is preferred.

The Mindset That Will Help You Succeed

You see a number and ask a useful question:

* Why is a high-performing segment receiving so little spend?
* Why are clicks strong but landing-page views weak?
* Why is ROAS improving while AOV is falling?
* Is the audience weak, or are we communicating the wrong reason to buy?

The goal is not to run more experiments. The goal is to learn faster and make performance work harder.

This Role May Not Be for You If

* You only report spend, CTR, and ROAS without diagnosing what changed.
* You know Ads Manager but are not curious about consumers, creative, and the funnel.
* You default to standard audience structures without a hypothesis.
* You wait for the creative team to decide what should be tested.
* You cannot explain whether a result is scalable.

How Success Will Be Measured

* Quality of campaign decisions and budget allocation.
* Ability to identify meaningful growth signals and funnel leaks.
* Improvement in acquisition efficiency, conversion, and scalable revenue.
* Quality and pace of creative, audience, and funnel experiments.
* Clarity of hypotheses, measurement, and post-test learning.
* Strength of collaboration with creative, content, design, analytics, and commerce teams.

Practical Details

* **Experience:** 2 to 3 years
* **Location:** Bangalore, in-office
* **Role type:** Full-time
* **Compensation:** ₹6 to 9 LPA
* **Reports to:** Head of Marketing

<aside>

**A strong candidate sounds like this:** "Something interesting is happening here. I want to understand why before I touch the budget."

</aside>

Pay: ₹600,000.00 - ₹900,000.00 per year

Experience:

* Performance marketing: 2 years (Preferred)
