title: Digital Marketing Manager
description:
Leadership Role

10+ Years Experience

Full-time

Bengaluru, Karnataka, India · Senior Management · Team Leadership

About Adze Studio

Adze Studio is a digital marketing and creative agency focused on building brands, driving measurable growth, and delivering impactful digital experiences. We work across digital strategy, performance marketing, SEO, social media, content, branding, and web solutions to help businesses strengthen their market presence and achieve sustainable growth.

We are looking for a highly strategic, commercially driven, and results-oriented Head of Digital Marketing with 10+ years of experience to lead our digital marketing function, drive business growth, strengthen client partnerships, and build a high-performing team.

This is a senior leadership role for someone who can combine strategic vision with strong execution capabilities, take complete ownership of marketing performance, manage multiple client portfolios, drive revenue growth, and establish scalable processes across the organisation.

Key Responsibilities1. Digital Marketing Strategy & Leadership

* Develop and execute comprehensive, integrated digital marketing strategies aligned with client business objectives, revenue targets, and organisational growth.
* Lead the overall digital marketing function, establishing clear goals, KPIs, performance benchmarks, and accountability across teams.
* Build scalable marketing frameworks, standard operating procedures, and performance-driven workflows.
* Identify emerging digital trends, technologies, platforms, and market opportunities to maintain the agency's competitive positioning.
* Drive data-backed decision-making, ensuring that all marketing initiatives are aligned with measurable business outcomes.
* Collaborate with senior management on business strategy, service expansion, and long-term organisational goals.

2. Performance Marketing & Revenue Growth

* Lead performance marketing strategies across Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads, YouTube, programmatic platforms, and other relevant paid media channels.
* Develop and oversee customer acquisition, lead generation, conversion optimisation, retargeting, and revenue growth strategies.
* Take ownership of campaign profitability, ROAS, CAC, CPL, conversion rates, and overall marketing ROI.
* Manage campaign budgets, forecasting, resource allocation, and optimisation to maximise returns.
* Build robust attribution, tracking, analytics, and reporting systems to measure the effectiveness of marketing investments.
* Identify opportunities for upselling, cross-selling, and expanding client accounts through performance-driven marketing solutions.

3. SEO, Organic Growth & Content Strategy

* Lead comprehensive SEO strategies, including technical SEO, on-page optimisation, off-page SEO, content optimisation, and organic growth.
* Drive organic traffic, search visibility, keyword performance, and qualified lead generation through sustainable SEO practices.
* Oversee content marketing, website optimisation, conversion-focused landing pages, and integrated content distribution strategies.
* Establish strategies for local SEO, international SEO, and emerging areas such as AI-driven search and Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO).
* Work closely with content, design, development, and performance teams to ensure consistent execution across digital channels.
* Monitor search engine algorithm changes, competitor strategies, and evolving search behaviours to continuously refine organic growth initiatives.

4. Client Relationship & Account Leadership

* Act as a senior strategic point of contact for key clients, understanding their business models, challenges, growth objectives, and market positioning.
* Lead strategic client meetings, quarterly business reviews, campaign presentations, and performance discussions.
* Translate client business requirements into actionable digital marketing strategies and measurable deliverables.
* Build long-term client relationships through proactive communication, transparency, strategic guidance, and consistent delivery.
* Manage escalations, resolve critical client concerns, and ensure timely execution of agreed deliverables.
* Identify opportunities to expand existing accounts, improve client retention, and strengthen long-term partnerships.
* Ensure that client expectations are aligned with campaign feasibility, budgets, timelines, and projected outcomes.

5. Team Management & Performance Development

* Lead, mentor, and develop a multidisciplinary digital marketing team comprising SEO specialists, performance marketers, social media executives, content strategists, designers, and client servicing professionals.
* Establish clear reporting structures, individual KPIs, ownership, and accountability across all team members.
* Drive a performance-oriented culture focused on productivity, quality, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.
* Conduct regular performance reviews, provide constructive feedback, and identify training and development requirements.
* Build effective team structures, optimise resource allocation, and ensure the right capabilities are available to support business growth.
* Identify future leaders within the team and develop succession plans for critical roles.
* Foster cross-functional collaboration and ensure seamless coordination between marketing, creative, development, and client servicing teams.

6. Business Development & Agency Growth

* Work closely with the business development team to identify new business opportunities, pitch strategies, and acquire high-value clients.
* Participate in client pitches, proposals, RFPs, presentations, and strategic consultations.
* Develop compelling digital marketing solutions, service offerings, and integrated marketing packages tailored to client requirements.
* Support revenue forecasting, account profitability, client acquisition, and business expansion initiatives.
* Identify new markets, industry verticals, and service opportunities to strengthen the agency's portfolio.
* Build strategic partnerships, explore new revenue streams, and contribute to the agency's overall growth strategy.
* Take ownership of improving client retention, increasing account value, and maintaining healthy project margins.

7. Analytics, Reporting & Performance Optimisation

* Establish a robust performance measurement framework across all digital marketing functions.
* Define, monitor, and review KPIs such as revenue growth, ROAS, ROI, CAC, CPL, conversion rates, organic traffic, lead quality, and client retention.
* Leverage tools such as Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console, Google Tag Manager, Looker Studio, Semrush, Ahrefs, and other relevant analytics platforms.
* Develop executive-level dashboards, monthly performance reports, and actionable business insights for management and clients.
* Identify underperforming campaigns, operational inefficiencies, and growth opportunities through data analysis.
* Implement continuous testing, experimentation, and optimisation frameworks across channels.
* Ensure marketing decisions are based on verified performance data rather than assumptions.

8. Social Media, Branding & Integrated Marketing

* Oversee integrated social media, content, influencer, brand awareness, and digital communication strategies.
* Ensure consistency in brand positioning, messaging, creative quality, and audience engagement across channels.
* Guide the creative team in developing performance-oriented creatives, campaign concepts, and impactful brand communication.
* Drive integrated campaigns that combine paid media, organic growth, content marketing, social media, and conversion optimisation.
* Monitor brand sentiment, audience behaviour, competitive positioning, and campaign effectiveness.
* Ensure that creative and communication strategies align with client objectives and measurable marketing outcomes.

9. Operational Excellence & Process Management

* Establish and maintain efficient workflows, project management systems, quality standards, and campaign approval processes.
* Ensure timely delivery of client projects, campaign launches, reporting, and strategic milestones.
* Monitor team utilisation, workload distribution, delivery timelines, and operational efficiency.
* Coordinate with internal stakeholders to minimise bottlenecks, resolve dependencies, and improve execution quality.
* Introduce automation, AI-powered tools, and technology-driven processes to improve productivity and reduce repetitive work.
* Ensure compliance with platform policies, data privacy requirements, client contracts, and internal business processes.
* Take complete ownership of delivery quality, operational discipline, and continuous process improvement.

10. Innovation, AI & Future-Ready Marketing

* Drive the adoption of AI-powered marketing tools, automation, predictive analytics, and advanced campaign optimisation techniques.
* Explore emerging technologies, including AI-assisted content workflows, marketing automation, personalisation, and advanced attribution.
* Evaluate new digital platforms, advertising formats, and growth opportunities relevant to client industries.
* Build an innovation-driven culture that encourages experimentation, measurable learning, and continuous improvement.
* Ensure that Adze Studio's digital marketing capabilities evolve in line with changing customer behaviour, technology, and market requirements.

Required Qualifications & Experience

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Digital Marketing, Communications, or a related field. An MBA or relevant postgraduate qualification is an added advantage.
* 10+ years of overall experience in digital marketing, with substantial experience in leading teams, managing clients, and driving measurable business outcomes.
* Proven experience in a digital marketing agency, marketing consultancy, or a fast-paced, multi-client environment.
* Demonstrated experience in managing integrated digital marketing strategies across paid media, SEO, content, social media, and analytics.
* Strong experience in managing significant marketing budgets, revenue targets, client portfolios, and cross-functional teams.
* Prior experience in a Head of Digital Marketing, Digital Marketing Director, Senior Digital Marketing Manager, or equivalent leadership role.
* Experience in client acquisition, strategic pitches, business development, and account growth.
* Strong understanding of digital marketing economics, profitability, forecasting, and performance measurement.
* Demonstrated ability to build teams, establish processes, manage escalations, and deliver against ambitious business objectives.

Technical Skills & Expertise

* Paid Media: Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads, YouTube Ads, display advertising, retargeting, and campaign optimisation.
* SEO: Technical SEO, on-page and off-page SEO, keyword research, website audits, content strategy, and GEO.
* Analytics: GA4, Google Tag Manager, Google Search Console, Looker Studio, and conversion tracking.
* SEO Tools: Semrush, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog, and other industry-standard platforms.

title: Senior manager - Sensory & Consumer Insights
description:
**Job Description :**

**About us:**

With over 200 brands sold in nearly 180 countries, Diageo is home to some of the world’s most iconic drinks. From Johnnie Walker and Guinness to Tanqueray, Smirnoff and Don Julio, we craft brands chosen for life’s moments — from everyday connections to landmark celebrations. Bring your talent, curiosity and ambition, and strive for your personal best alongside people who challenge, support and learn from each other. Together, as one outstanding team, we keep learning, improving and raising the bar for our brands, our business and each other. Join us and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more.

**About the Function:**

Supply Chain & Manufacturing is where our brands are made, moved and delivered to the world. With over half of our people working across more than 100 sites, this is a complex, large-scale operation that brings together production, logistics, engineering and supplier partnerships. It’s fast-paced and hands-on, with teams working together to ensure quality, efficiency and sustainability at every stage. From sourcing ingredients to getting products into customers’ hands, you’ll play a role in delivering the brands people know and love.

**About the role:**

**Senior Manager, Sensory Science**

Diageo India Bangalore Research & Development

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**·

  

**Sensory strategy and governance:** Define sensory strategy, protocols, standards and governance across innovation, renovation, quality and commercialization.

**Sensory study design:** Design fit-for-purpose sensory studies for product development, benchmarking, quality, claims and consumer understanding.· **Panel leadership:** Recruit, train, calibrate and manage expert sensory panels; establish panel performance monitoring and accreditation.

**Innovation support:** Translate sensory and consumer insights into product design direction for aroma, taste, mouthfeel, balance, aftertaste and overall experience.

**Consumer and flavour intelligence:** Integrate consumer insights, market trends, launched products, food-service inspirations and expert inputs into innovation pipelines.

**Quality and manufacturing support:** Support sensory quality governance, first batch approvals, specifications, investigations and corrective actions across units.

**Claims substantiation:** Design evidence to support sensory claims such as smoothness, refreshment, taste superiority, flavour notes and differentiation.· **Digital and analytics:** Drive use of digital sensory platforms, dashboards, automated reporting and AI-enabled insight tools.

**SENSORY EXPERTISE REQUIRED**·

* Descriptive Analysis / QDA, consensus profiling and product benchmarking. Discrimination testing: Triangle, Duo-Trio, Tetrad, Paired Comparison, A-not-A and similarity testing.
* JAR, Penalty Analysis, CATA/RATA, preference mapping and drivers of liking.
* Threshold studies: detection, recognition and JND; sensory shelf-life and product matching.
* Panel performance assessment, repeatability, reproducibility, agreement analysis and training design.
* Strong understanding of flavour chemistry, ingredient functionality, aroma-taste interactions and mouthfeel.

**STATISTICAL AND DIGITAL CAPABILITY**·

* Strong working knowledge of ANOVA, Mixed Models, PCA, PLS, Cluster Analysis, DOE, Penalty Analysis and Preference Mapping.
* Ability to convert complex sensory and consumer data into clear business recommendations.
* Hands-on experience with tools such as XLSTAT, JMP, R, SPSS, Compusense, RedJade, EyeQuestion or equivalent platforms.
* Comfort with data visualization, dashboards, automated analysis and AI-enabled insights tools.

**QUALIFICATION AND EXPERIENCE**·

  

**Education:** Master's or PhD in Sensory Science, Food Science, Food Technology, Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Consumer Science, Statistics or related discipline.

**Experience:** 6-8 years in Sensory Science, Product Development, Flavour Science or related R&D roles.

**Industry background:** Beverages, alcohol, spirits, RTDs, flavours, food, FMCG or consumer products preferred.

**Panel experience:** Proven experience in building, managing and governing expert sensory panels in innovation and quality contexts.

**LEADERSHIP COMPETENCIES**:

* Strategic and consumer-centric mindset with strong scientific rigour.
* Ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders across R&D, Marketing, Quality, Supply, Regulatory and external partners.
* Strong communication, storytelling and ability to simplify data for leadership decisions.
* High ownership, accountability, result orientation and comfort working through ambiguity.
* Coaching mindset with the ability to build capability across R&D, Quality and manufacturing teams.
* Curiosity for flavours, consumers, culture, product trends and emerging technologies.

**EXTERNAL AND INTERNAL INTERFACES**·

  

**Internal:** R&D, Product Development, Innovation, Marketing, Quality, Supply, Regulatory, Legal, Procurement, Commercial and manufacturing units.· **External:** Flavour houses, sensory and consumer research agencies, fermentation experts, ingredient suppliers, universities, start-ups, mixologists and brand ambassadors.

**SUCCESS MEASURES**·

* Sensory insights influencing key innovation, renovation and quality decisions. Consumer-preferred and differentiated products delivered to market.
* Strong sensory panel capability and governance across R&D and manufacturing units.
* Faster, more confident product development and commercialization decisions.
* Robust sensory evidence for claims and product communication.
* Improved sensory consistency across manufacturing sites.
* Successful adoption of digital sensory systems, dashboards and analytics.

**Working with us**  
Flexibility is key to our success. Talk to us about what flexibility means to you, so that you’re supported to manage your wellbeing and balance your priorities from day one.  
  
We recognise and value performance, offering our people a highly competitive Rewards and Benefits package including:Our purpose is crafting iconic drinks chosen for life’s moments. And it’s our people, with their different experiences, perspectives and talents, who make that possible.We value diversity in its broadest sense and want everyone to feel they can belong, contribute and strive for their personal best. You’ll work alongside people with different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives — challenging, supporting and learning from one another as one outstanding team.Together, we’re constantly learning and improving, combining the strength of our people, capabilities and iconic brands to raise the bar, grow and win. Wherever you join us, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute, make an impact and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more.Ready to bring your best This could be your opportunity.

  

*If you require a reasonable adjustment, please ensure that you capture this information when you submit your application.*

  

***Recruitment Scam Warning:***

*Protecting candidates is very important to us. All communications regarding your application will come from an email address ending in @diageo.com. In our recruitment process, we'll never ask for money.*

title: Manager – B2B Insurance Lead Generation
description:
Job Description

**Manager – B2B Insurance Lead Generation**

Company: Upstox

Location: Bengaluru

Work arrangement: 5 days in the office

Function: Insurance – B2B Sales (SDR / Lead Generation team)

**About Upstox**
----------------

At Upstox, we’re building the future of investing — simple, powerful, and for everyone. We're one of India’s fastest-growing fintech platforms, backed by the best in the business, including Mr. Ratan Tata and Tiger Global, and on a mission to make wealth creation accessible to every Indian. From first-time investors to seasoned traders, millions trust us to power their financial journeys. We're not just moving fast — we’re moving with purpose. If you thrive in a high-energy, high-impact environment, you're in the right place.

**The Role: Manager – B2B Insurance Lead Generation**
-----------------------------------------------------

Upstox Insurance is building a B2B Employee Benefits (EB) business that helps corporates protect their employees through group insurance. As Manager – B2B Insurance Lead Generation, you’ll own the top of this funnel — building the lead management strategy, defining and building the list of target corporates, and leading a team of SDRs that consistently delivers the number and quality of leads the B2B sales team needs, month on month.

This is a player-coach role. Alongside managing the team, you’ll carry your own outreach target and personally call and engage decision-makers at target corporates. If you love building pipeline from scratch and leading from the front, this role is for you.

**What You’ll Own**
-------------------

**Lead Generation Strategy & Lead Management**

* **Lead management framework**: Design and own the end-to-end framework — sourcing, qualification criteria, lead scoring, handover to sales, follow-up cadences and recycling of cold leads.

* **Ideal customer profile**: Define the ICP by industry, employee strength, geography and current benefits set-up, and refine it based on conversion data.

* **Outreach playbooks**: Build multi-channel playbooks across cold calling, email, LinkedIn, referrals, partner channels and events.

* **Renewal-cycle planning**: Plan outreach around corporate policy renewal cycles so prospects are engaged well ahead of their group insurance renewal dates.

**Target Account List Building**

* **Target list**: Build, segment and continuously enrich a target list of suitable corporates, with mapped decision-makers across HR, Finance, Admin and leadership.

* **Research & data tools**: Use tools such as LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo and ZoomInfo to identify accounts and verify contact data.

* **Data hygiene & prioritisation**: Maintain data hygiene and prioritise accounts by size, fit and likelihood to convert.

**Pipeline Delivery to the Sales Team**

* **Qualified pipeline**: Ensure the B2B sales team receives the agreed number of qualified leads and meetings every month.

* **Monthly targets**: Agree monthly lead and meeting targets with B2B sales leadership, aligned to sales capacity and revenue goals.

* **Feedback loop**: Run a regular feedback loop with sales on lead quality and conversion, and adjust targeting, messaging and qualification accordingly.

**Team Leadership & Motivation**

* **Hiring & training**: Hire, onboard and train SDRs on prospecting, pitch, objection handling and Employee Benefits products (e.g., Group Health, Group Personal Accident, Group Term Life).

* **Targets & reviews**: Set clear daily, weekly and monthly activity and outcome targets for each team member, and review progress through huddles and dashboards.

* **Coaching & culture**: Coach the team through call audits, role-plays and one-on-ones; drive a high-energy, performance-oriented culture.

**Individual Contribution**

* **Personal target**: Carry a personal monthly target for outreach, calls and meetings set.

* **CXO outreach**: Personally call and engage senior decision-makers (CHROs, CFOs, founders) at priority and large accounts, and set up meetings for the sales team.

* **Lead from the front**: Take the lead on strategic accounts and new segments to build playbooks the team can replicate.

**Tools, Reporting & Analytics**

* **Lead management stack**: Own the CRM, dialers and sales engagement tools, and ensure full and disciplined adoption by the team.

* **Dashboards & MIS**: Build dashboards and share weekly and monthly MIS with the Business Head on activity, pipeline, conversion and target achievement.

* **Data-led allocation**: Use data to identify what is working by channel, segment and message, and reallocate team effort accordingly.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* **Collaboration**: Work with Marketing on campaigns, content and inbound lead flow; with Sales on smooth handovers; and with Product and Operations to bring market feedback back into the EB offering.

**How Success Is Measured**
---------------------------

* **Qualified leads delivered**: Sales-qualified leads / meetings handed over to the B2B sales team each month vs. target.

* **Meetings held**: Share of scheduled meetings that take place with the right decision-maker.

* **Funnel conversion**: Lead meeting proposal conversion rates, tracked by industry, company size and channel.

* **Team productivity**: Calls, connects, emails and LinkedIn touches per SDR per day/week.

* **Self-outreach target**: The Manager’s personal monthly target for outreach, calls and meetings set.

* **Data quality**: Accuracy and completeness of the target account list and CRM records.

**Who You Are**
---------------

* 5+ years of experience leading a B2B SDR / lead generation team, with a proven track record of delivering monthly pipeline targets.

* Strong understanding of lead management: ICP definition, list building, qualification frameworks, lead scoring and sales handover.

* Hands-on with lead management and sales engagement tools — CRM, dialers, LinkedIn Sales Navigator and data platforms.

* Excellent cold calling and outreach skills, with the confidence to engage CXO and HR leadership directly.

* Demonstrated ability to hire, coach, motivate and retain a high-performing team.

* Data-driven, with comfort in building and reading dashboards and MIS.

* Excellent communication skills.

* Willing to work on-site from Bengaluru.

**Good to have**

* Experience in insurance, Employee Benefits or group health, or B2B selling to HR and Finance teams (e.g., HR-tech, payroll, fintech, SaaS).

* Familiarity with insurance distribution and the IRDAI regulatory environment.

* Graduate degree; MBA preferred.

**Why This Role Rocks**
-----------------------

* You’ll build the top of the funnel for a brand-new B2B Employee Benefits business at one of India’s fastest-growing fintech platforms.

* You’ll have high ownership and visibility — your pipeline directly drives the revenue of the B2B insurance business.

* You’ll be a true player-coach, building a high-performing SDR team while leading from the front with CXOs.

* You’ll work with a passionate, fast-moving team across insurance, sales, marketing and product.

* Every corporate you bring in helps protect thousands of employees and their families.

By applying for this position, you acknowledge that you have reviewed our **Prospective Employee Privacy Notice**, which outlines how Upstox collects, uses, and protects your Personal Information ("PI"). I accept Upstox's Prospective Employee Privacy Notice.

Upstox is an Equal Opportunity Employer; all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status, or other characteristics.

**Company Description**

Ralph Lauren Corporation (NYSE:RL) is a global leader in the design, marketing and distribution of premium lifestyle products in five categories: apparel, accessories, home, fragrances, and hospitality. For more than 50 years, Ralph Lauren's reputation and distinctive image have been consistently developed across an expanding number of products, brands and international markets. At Ralph Lauren, we unite and inspire the communities within our company as well as those in which we serve by amplifying voices and perspectives to create a culture of belonging, ensuring inclusion, and fairness for all. We foster a culture of inclusion through: Talent, Education & Communication, Employee Groups and Celebration.

  
  
**Position Overview**

**Purpose & Scope -**

The Senior Manager, AI Engineering is responsible for leading the design, development, and deployment of scalable AI solutions that accelerate Ralph Lauren's transformation into an AI-enabled enterprise. This role combines strong technical leadership with hands-on execution to deliver production-grade AI applications, agentic systems, and reusable engineering capabilities across the organization. This leader partners closely with AI Strategy, Enterprise Architecture, Data Engineering, Product, Security, Governance, and Business Technology teams to translate prioritized use cases into secure, scalable, and high-impact AI solutions built on Microsoft Azure and Databricks.

**The role is responsible for:**

* Enterprise AI and agentic AI solution delivery
* Multi-agent orchestration and intelligent workflow automation
* LLMOps and MLOps engineering practices
* AI integration, observability, and operational excellence
* Responsible AI implementation and governance adherence
* Engineering team leadership and capability development

This leader is expected to drive engineering excellence while enabling rapid experimentation, innovation, and scalable AI adoption across business functions.

  
**Essential Duties & Responsibilities**

**Key Roles & Responsibilities**

**AI Solution Delivery**

* Lead the design, development, and implementation of enterprise AI solutions aligned with business priorities.
* Translate prioritized AI use cases into scalable, production-ready applications and services.
* Partner with Product Managers and business stakeholders to define solution requirements, delivery plans, and measurable outcomes.
* Drive disciplined execution across prototyping, engineering, testing, deployment, and production support.

**Agentic AI & Intelligent Automation**

* Design and implement agentic AI solutions using Azure AI services, Databricks, vector platforms, orchestration frameworks, and modern LLM ecosystems.
* Build and maintain multi-agent workflows, orchestration frameworks, and AI-powered automation solutions.
* Develop reusable patterns for memory management, tool usage, reasoning workflows, human-in-the-loop controls, and enterprise action execution.

**AI Platform Engineering**

* Contribute to enterprise AI platforms, reusable services, SDKs, templates, and engineering accelerators.
* Develop and maintain APIs, integrations, and shared AI capabilities supporting multiple business use cases.
* Partner with Data Engineering to ensure AI-ready data foundations and scalable access patterns in Azure and Databricks.
* Support technical decisions related to AI services, inference, model deployment, infrastructure, and integrations.

**Engineering Excellence & Operations**

* Establish and promote standards for CI/CD, testing, release management, monitoring, and operational support.
* Implement LLMOps and MLOps practices including evaluation, prompt management, experimentation, telemetry, and runtime optimization.
* Lead production-readiness reviews for reliability, scalability, security, and cost efficiency.
* Monitor performance and drive continuous improvement through operational analytics.

**Governance, Security & Responsible AI**

* Ensure AI solutions comply with enterprise security, privacy, compliance, governance, and Responsible AI standards.
* Partner with Security and Governance teams to implement guardrails, auditability, policy enforcement, and risk controls.
* Support observability frameworks including telemetry, evaluation, performance tracking, and drift detection.

**Team Leadership & Talent Development**

* Lead, mentor, and develop a team of AI engineers and technical specialists.
* Provide technical coaching and hands-on guidance throughout the software development lifecycle.
* Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, engineering rigor, and continuous learning.
* Support recruiting, onboarding, performance enablement, and career development.
* Drive collaboration across strategy, architecture, data, infrastructure, product, and business teams.

  
**Experience, Skills, and Knowledge**

**Qualifications & Experience**

* 8+ years of experience in software engineering, AI/ML engineering, or data engineering, including technical leadership responsibility.

* Strong hands-on engineering skills with the ability to architect, prototype, review, and troubleshoot AI systems.
* Deep experience with Microsoft Azure, including Azure AI Services, Azure Machine Learning, AKS, API Management, and cloud-native engineering patterns.
* Strong experience with Databricks, Lakehouse architecture, AI/ML pipelines, vector search, and scalable data processing.

* Hands-on experience with frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, CrewAI, OpenAI SDKs, MCP-based ecosystems, or equivalent technologies.
* Strong understanding of LLMOps and MLOps, including deployment, prompt management, evaluation, observability, experimentation, governance, and runtime optimization.
* Experience with API-first architecture, microservices, event-driven systems, cloud-native platforms, and enterprise integration patterns.
* Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills across technical and business teams.

**Preferred Experience:**

* Familiarity with AI-native commerce and Agentic Commerce ecosystems, including UCP, ACP, and autonomous transaction orchestration patterns.

**The opportunity**

  

The product owner will be responsible for the technology analysis, end user research, future product planning, and cradle-to-grave life-cycle management of the product that is developed. You will build products from existing ideas, and help to develop new ideas based on your industry experience and your contact with customers and prospects. You must possess a unique blend of business and technical savvy; a big-picture vision, create a vision of the product from an end user perspective, and the drive to make that vision a reality. You must enjoy spending time in the market to understand their problems, and find innovative solutions for the broader market. You must be able to communicate with all areas of the company. You will work with a technology counterpart to define product release requirements. You will work closely with various stakeholders to make business decisions and create product strategies that ensure the long-term sustainability of the products or tools. You will also serve as the internal and external evangelist for your product offering, occasionally working with the sales channel and key customers.

**Your key responsibilities**

  

* Identifying, evaluating, and planning new software products using lean/agile principles.
* Creating use-cases and related requirements materials for use by our development/technology teams
* Defining minimum viable product features (MVP) and/or pivoting existing products.
* Propose product strategy changes because of competitive changes in the marketplace.
* Working cross-functionally, define and drive alignment and implementation of the software roadmap including products, services, and solutions.
* Closely collaborate with cross-functional teams across business, technical and implementation teams to define product requirements to build and own the product roadmap.
* Manage and prioritize the product backlog together with product management.
* Report to Global leadership on product status, management of budget etc.
* Develop an in-depth understanding of customers’ challenges and needs to clearly define product requirements
* Manage the product life cycle
* Assist in the build / buy strategy including recommendations for current solutions
* Communicate and drive organizational alignment on software deployment with key stakeholders including end users
* Works with the technology and client services teams to build and enhance products from existing ideas, and help develop new concepts based on industry research and the needs of end user

  

**Skills and attributes for success**

  

* Experience with HR / Payroll technology solutions and a good understanding of global HRIS / HR / Payroll technology landscape
* Strong problem-solving skills and willingness to roll up one’s sleeves to get the job done
* Ability to effectively work as a leader in a cross functional team environment including business and product development, supply chain and procurement processes and execution dependencies
* Strong track record of influencing successful product/solution vision/roadmap and executing to a plan
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills and expertise in communicating with teams across geographies
* Excellent knowledge of Design Thinking and User Experience methodologies.
* Strategic thinker who is comfortable in a fast-paced, always-on, ambiguous start-up environment

  

**To qualify for the role you must have**

  

* Bachelor’s or Master's degree in engineering (Computer Science/ Technology
* 12 - 15 years of experience in IT/software industry with at least 6 years in capacity of product manager.

  

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

  

* Knowledge and experience in dealing with cross platform mobile applications.
* Demonstrated success in delivering high quality technology products/services in a very high growth environment where priorities shift rapidly.
* Proven ability to develop product and marketing strategies and effectively communicate recommendations to executive management

  

**What we offer**

  

EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.

  

* **Continuous learning:** You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* **Success as defined by you:** We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* **Transformative leadership:** We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* **Diverse and inclusive culture:** You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

  

**EY | Building a better working world**

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

description:
Life is too short for a boring career, so build an extraordinary one with us. We believe your career should spark the same thrill and curiosity as your personal interests. Creativity drives everything we do, turning ideas into meaningful impact. With opportunities across brands, markets, and divisions, your growth knows no boundaries. Read on to know more about what’s in store for you!
  
  
**JOB TITLE:** Brand Manager, L’Oréal Dermatological Beauty Division (Mumbai)
  
  
Hello, we’re L’Oréal. We're not just building brands, we're shaping how the world experiences beauty (and it takes a lot of cool jobs to do it). Intrigued? Keep reading, this might be the opportunity you've been searching for.
  
  
A Day in the Life
  
  
As an individual contributor reporting to the Brand Business Leader in Mumbai, you will orchestrate product launches and drive sustained growth for core pillar ranges across India. You will connect science, digital innovation, and consumer insights to expand our market presence.
  
  

* Orchestrate new product launches and core catalogue activations across digital, social, retail, e-commerce, and traditional channels.
* Gather consumer and competitor insights, translating them into strategic briefs, creative storytelling, and tailored point-of-sale materials.
* Steer advocacy and influencer programmes, managing agency relationships, content creators, and medical stakeholder engagement.
* Partner transversally with Sales, Medical, Supply Chain, and Finance to align commercial execution and ensure sales forecasting accuracy.
* Track performance KPIs, manage brand budgets, and leverage digital and AI-enabled tools to increase marketing effectiveness.

We Are Looking For
  
  
You bring collaborative agility, commercial acumen, and an entrepreneurial approach to health-led beauty innovation. You bring:
  
  

* Brand Development: Proven track record in operational marketing, product launches, and integrated campaign delivery within beauty, FMCG, or healthcare.
* Consumer & Market Insight: Ability to analyse consumer data and identify market drivers to shape effective go-to-market strategies.
* Digital & Influencer Activation: Practical experience managing owned social channels, e-commerce campaigns, and advocacy networks.
* Collaborative Leadership: Strong stakeholder management across internal multidisciplinary teams (medical, sales, supply chain) and external agencies.
* Activation Excellence: Analytical rigour to control budgets, monitor campaign ROI, and support accurate business planning.

What’s In It For You
  
  

* A place for you to leave your comfort zone and grow beyond your potential (here, you’ll be encouraged to try new things and take risks!)
* Real responsibility from day 1, there’s no sitting on the sidelines at L’Oréal.
* An environment where people of every ethnicity, social background, age, religion, gender and sexual orientation as well as people with disabilities are accepted, can speak up, will thrive and are celebrated!
* A place where you can contribute to something bigger! Many of our brands have societal /environmental causes to make concrete difference.

**WHO WE ARE:**  
For 115 years, L’Oréal, the world’s leading beauty player, has devoted itself to one thing only: fulfilling the beauty aspirations of consumers around the world.
  
  
With our broad portfolio of 37 international brands and ambitious sustainability commitments in our L’Oréal for the Future program, we offer every person around the world the best in terms of quality, efficacy, safety, sincerity and responsibility, while celebrating beauty in its infinite plurality.
  
  
Present in India since 1994, L'Oréal India is a 100% subsidiary of L'Oréal S.A. Today, L'Oréal India is present on all distribution channels with 27 brands, available in consumer channels (L'Oréal Paris, Garnier, Maybelline New York, NYX Professional Makeup); in hair and beauty salons (L'Oréal Professionnel, Matrix, Kérastase, Redken); in selective distribution (Kiehl's, Lancôme, Yves Saint Laurent), CeraVe and La Roche-Posay in pharmacies and drugstores, and perfumes and make-up sold through L'Oréal International Distribution (Armani, Prada, Valentino, Ralph Lauren, Diesel, Victor & Rolf, Mugler, Azzaro, Maison Margiela, Cacharel, Guy Laroche, Urban Decay, Paloma Picasso, Youth To The People).
  
  
L'Oréal India employs more than 1,800 people in its head office in Mumbai, four regional offices, two production plants in Chakan (Maharashtra) and Baddi (Himachal Pradesh), two Research and Innovation centers in Mumbai (Maharashtra) and Bengaluru (Karnataka) and one India Technology Hub in Hyderabad.
  
  
In India, L'Oréal's Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) initiatives are built around three pillars: empowerment, environment and education. In addition to the group's CSR commitments, L'Oréal's brands (L'Oréal Paris, Garnier, Maybelline New York, Kérastase, Matrix, L'Oréal Professionnel) are also leading community impact initiatives in India.
  
  
L’Oréal is committed to building a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. L’Oréal closely prohibits discrimination against any employee or applicant for employment because of the individual’s race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Social Media Manager
description:
**What you'll actually be doing**

We're an early startup, which means you won't be handed a neat little job description and told to stay in your lane. You'll have ownership of how Wingmann shows up, grows, and gets people to use our product.

**Your responsibilities will include:**

**Social media:** Own our Instagram, LinkedIn and X. Plan the content, come up with

ideas, write scripts, create, edit, publish and figure out what works.

**Content strategy:** Build recurring content formats, experiment with new ideas, spot

trends worth jumping on, and make people actually want to follow us.

**Growth & user acquisition:** Find creative ways to get people onto Wingmann.

Experiment with organic growth, campaigns, collaborations, and performance marketing.

**Marketing & outreach:** Find the right communities, creators, partners and opportunities

to get Wingmann in front of the right people.

**Offline events & activations:** Take things off the internet. Organise events, build

partnerships, come up with unconventional activations and get people talking about

Wingmann.

**Analytics & experimentation:** Track what's working, what's flopping, and why. Use the

numbers to make better decisions instead of blindly posting and hoping for the best.

**A little bit of everything else:** We're a startup. If there's a good idea worth pursuing,

you'll probably have a hand in making it happen.

**You'd probably be a good fit if...**

You spend an unreasonable amount of time thinking about why some content works and

other content doesn't.

You have ideas beyond "let's post a reel about this trending audio."

You can turn a random observation into a great piece of content.

You're comfortable going from brainstorming to writing, shooting, editing, and publishing

without needing five people to make it happen.

You understand that views are nice, but growth, user acquisition and actual business

outcomes matter too.

You can take ownership, figure things out independently, and move without waiting for

someone to tell you every next step, but can work with a team and be open to feedback.  
You're happy to experiment, get things wrong, learn and try again.

You can organise an offline event one day and analyse campaign performance the next.

You don't need to be an expert at everything on day one. But you do need to be curious,

resourceful, and willing to get your hands dirty.

**What this role is NOT**

A job where you just schedule posts and wait for the next brief.

A job where success means posting consistently and calling it a day.

A job where you say,

"That's not my responsibility."

You'll have creative freedom, real ownership, and the opportunity to shape how a startup grows. In return, we expect initiative, accountability and a bias towards getting things done.

**A few practical details**

**Role:** Full-time Social Media & Marketing Manager

**Location:** Bangalore (or open to relocate)

**Experience:** Open to the right person. Show us what you've done, what you've learnt, and what you can bring to the table.

**Interested?**

Send us your resume, portfolio or examples of work you're proud of. A few words about what

you'd do differently with Wingmann's marketing would be even better.

No elaborate cover letters needed. We'd rather see how you think.

And if you've read this far and already have content ideas for us, we're listening.

**Apply Here:** https://wingmann.co/careers | +91 95350 51145

title: Client Partner Manager
description:
At Apple, we work every day to create products that enrich people’s lives. We want to help people in every part of their lives that we can, including making the world’s best content easily and beautifully available to the hundreds of millions of people around the globe who use Apple products. Our Advertising Platforms organization enables a thriving ecosystem for content creators, publishers, and developers by helping them monetize their work while enabling users to discover high-quality content seamlessly across Apple devices. With the continued growth of Apple Ads within the App Store where a significant majority of app downloads originate from search this platform has become a critical channel for app discovery and performance marketing for iOS developers globally.
  
  
In this role, you will grow, lead and develop a team that is responsible for revenue generation and customer happiness across your assigned market or region. You’ll use your knowledge of developers, advertisers and agencies to create and maintain positive and productive relationships with marketers of all size and type. You’ll quickly gain the respect and support of both management and other employees by achieving business goals and demonstrating good judgment, business insight, balance, objectivity, collaboration, quiet confidence, and trustworthiness. You will also have direct management responsibility for a team of Client Partners (our client facing sales team) and the Platform Specialists.  
  
**Description**  
The Client Partner Manager (CPM) will lead the Bangalore team, responsible for sourcing, managing, and growing strategic relationships with leading clients, developers, and agencies. This role requires a strong player-coach leader who can effectively develop and inspire the team while remaining hands-on in managing and expanding relationships with our most strategic customers.  
The CPM will oversee the Client Partner team while also managing the Platform Specialist team, who is responsible for optimizing Apple Ads accounts, maximizing revenue performance, and ensuring exceptional customer satisfaction.  
This role will be responsible for driving a high-performance sales culture that consistently delivers against revenue targets, customer satisfaction (CSI) goals, and key performance metrics such as CPT and CPA. The CPM will lead by example, setting a high standard of execution and ensuring the team delivers extraordinary service and strategic value to all customers.  
The CPM will also ensure strong operational discipline across the team, ensuring the team are reporting their business through the correct channels, utilizing salesforce and other internal business management tools.  
In addition, the role will partner closely with cross-functional teams, including Marketing and Product, to provide market feedback, share customer insights, and inform product development. A strong understanding of the broader digital marketing ecosystem including attribution, viewability, measurement, and competitive dynamics is essential.  
Overall, this is an exciting opportunity to lead a best-in-class sales organization. The CPM will be responsible for driving revenue growth, expanding strategic partnerships and strengthening client retention, while ensuring the team continues to deliver market-leading service.  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**  
Demonstrated ability to build strong team cultures and to attract, develop, and retain top talent.  
A hands-on player-coach leadership style, with the ability to both lead strategically and actively engage in key client relationships and sales opportunities.  
Strong network and relationships across clients, agencies, and developers.  
Ability to engage and influence stakeholders across all levels from C-suite executives to day-to-day marketing planners.  
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to listen actively, influence cross-functional stakeholders, and clearly articulate strategic business visions internally and externally.  
Proven ability to foster collaboration and drive shared success across cross-functional teams.  
Team-first mindset with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced and dynamic environment while adapting to new business opportunities.  
Highly professional demeanor with a positive and solutions-oriented attitude.  
Experience in gaming app category preferred.  
Experience managing a sales team preferred  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**  
Bachelors Degree educated, MBA a plus  
Deep understanding of the mobile app economy and strong passion for the evolving digital marketing landscape.  
Significant experience in online, digital, or performance marketing, ideally within the mobile ecosystem and data-driven marketing environment.  
Solid expertise in performance marketing, including campaign optimization, measurement, and growth strategies.

title: Senior Category Manager–South Business
description:
Senior Category Manager–South

Business

Location: Bengaluru | Company: AppsForBharat (Sri Mandir)

About AppsForBharat

At AppsForBharat, we are building Sri Mandir, a platform that helps millions of devotees

connect with their faith through technology. Our v ision is to make religious and spiritual

experiences more accessible by combining deep cultural understanding with innovative

digital experiences.

We are looking for a Senior Category Manager – South Business to build and scale our

South-focused puja business. This is an entrepreneurial role for someone who can own

business outcomes end-to-end, make sharp commercial decisions, and build a differentiated

category by understanding customer needs, rituals, product assortment, and pricing.

The Role

As the Senior Category Manager, you will own the South business P&L and drive its growth

by building a relevant product catalog, defining pricing strategies, identifying new business

opportunities, and improving app orders and customer conversion.

You will work closely with the puja calendar owner, marketing, creative, product, and

retention teams, to translate regional rituals, festivals, and customer insights into

commercially successful offerings.

This role offers the opportunity to build and scale a business from the ground up, with

significant ownership and the ability to shape category strategy.

Key Responsibilities

1. Business & P&L Ownership

* Own the end-to-end P&L for the South business, driving revenue growth, profitability,

and sustainable business performance.

* Define business goals, key performance indicators, and category-level growth plans.

* Identify opportunities to improve margins, increase average order value (AOV), and

drive repeat purchases.

* Track business performance, identify gaps, and take data-backed decisions to

improve outcomes.

2. Category Strategy & Catalog Development

* Build and scale a differentiated South-focused puja catalog based on regional

customer needs, rituals, and preferences.

* Define product assortment, SKUs, bundles, and offerings for key rituals, festivals,

and everyday devotional needs.

* Identify underserved customer segments and new category opportunities.

* Work with relevant teams to evaluate product feasibility, availability, and operational

readiness before launching new offerings.

* Continuously refine the catalog based on customer demand, sales performance, and

emerging opportunities.

3. Pricing & Commercial Strategy

* Define pricing strategies for new and existing offerings, balancing customer value,

competitiveness, and profitability.

* Run pricing experiments to understand customer willingness to pay and improve

conversion.

* Evaluate product-level economics, margins, discounts, and promotional

effectiveness.

* Develop strategies for bundling, upselling, and cross-selling to improve revenue per

order.

4. Growth & App Order Expansion

* Drive growth in South business orders through relevant category initiatives and

customer-focused offerings.

* Identify opportunities across app discovery, merchandising, conversion funnels, and

customer journeys.

* Partner with product and growth teams to improve category visibility, conversion, and

repeat engagement.

* Analyse customer behaviour and business data to identify growth levers and

prioritise high-impact initiatives.

5. Festival, Ritual & Consumer Insights

* Partner closely with the puja calendar owner to understand upcoming festivals,

regional rituals, and high-intent purchase occasions.

* Translate festival calendars and ritual insights into relevant products, bundles,

campaigns, and launch plans.

* Develop a deep understanding of South Indian devotional practices and differences

in customer preferences across regions.

* Use customer feedback, market research, and sales trends to continuously improve

the category proposition.

6. Cross-functional Execution

* Collaborate with marketing and creative teams to develop compelling campaigns,

product communication, and festival-led initiatives.

* Work with product, operations, and other relevant teams to ensure smooth execution

of category launches and business initiatives.

* Drive alignment across stakeholders and ensure timely execution of priorities.

* Take ownership of outcomes while operating with limited hand-holding in a

fast-paced environment.

What We're Looking For

* Category management experience: Experience managing a category or business

with clear ownership of commercial outcomes, revenue, or P&L.

* Strong commercial acumen: Ability to make sound decisions on pricing,

assortment, margins, promotions, and business growth.

* Entrepreneurial mindset: Comfortable building from the ground up, navigating

ambiguity, and taking end-to-end ownership.

* Analytical thinking: Ability to interpret business metrics, identify opportunities, and

convert insights into actionable growth plans.

* Customer-centricity: Strong understanding of consumer behaviour and the ability to

build offerings around customer needs.

* Execution excellence: Ability to work cross-functionally, manage multiple priorities,

and deliver measurable business outcomes.

* Learning agility: Curiosity to understand South Indian rituals, regional nuances, and

devotional customer needs, even without prior domain expertise.

Preferred Experience

* Experience in quick commerce, e-commerce, D2C, online marketplaces, or other

consumer internet businesses.

* Experience managing a category or business with revenue and profitability targets.

* Exposure to assortment planning, pricing experiments, promotions, merchandising,

and conversion optimization.

* Familiarity with South Indian markets, regional consumer behaviour, or devotional

categories is an advantage, but not mandatory.

Why Join Us?

* Own and build a business with direct accountability for P&L and growth.

* Work at the intersection of consumer internet, commerce, and India's rich devotional

ecosystem.

* Build differentiated offerings for a large and diverse customer base.

* Work closely with cross-functional teams and influence business strategy.

* Take on an entrepreneurial role with the opportunity to create meaningful,

measurable impact.

title: Senior Engineer – Marketing Integrations & APIs
description:
**Job Description**
-------------------

**Be part of something bigger. Decode the future.**

At Electrolux, as a leading global appliance company, we strive every day to shape living for the better for our consumers, our people and our planet. We share ideas and collaborate so that together, we can develop solutions that deliver enjoyable and sustainable living.  
  
Come join us as you are. We believe diverse perspectives make us stronger and more innovative. In our global community of people from 100+ countries, we listen to each other, actively contribute, and grow together.  
  
**All about the role:**  
  
We are looking for a Senior Engineer to help driving our global MarTech strategy forward, with a particular focus on cloud-based architecture (Azure preferred) and API integrations. You will work closely with cross-functional teams - from engineering and product to data and CX teams - ensuring scalable, future-ready solutions that enhance both consumer and business outcomes. “*Great innovation happens when complexity is tamed, and possibilities are unleashed.*”

That’s what we firmly believe!

Join our team at Electrolux, where we lead Digital Transformation efforts. We specialize in developing centralized solutions to enhance inter-system communications, integrate third-party platforms, and establish ourselves as the Master Data within Electrolux. Our focus is on delivering high-performance and scalable solutions that consistently achieve top-quality results on a global scale. Currently operating in Europe and North America, we are expanding our footprint to all regions worldwide.

**About the CDI Experience Organization:**

The Consumer Direct Interaction Experience Organization is a Digital Product Organization responsible for delivering tech solutions to our end-users and consumers across both pre-purchase and post-purchase journeys. We are organized in 15+ digital product areas, providing solutions ranging from Contact Center, E-commerce, Marketing, and Identity to AI. You will play a key role in ensuring the right sizing, right skillset, and core competency across these product areas.

**What you’ll do:**

* Design and implement scalable, secure, cloud-native architecture patterns to support integration across key marketing platforms including BlueConic (CDP), Iterable (Marketing Automation), SAP CDC (Identity & Consent), Qualtrics (Experience Management), and Dynamic Yield (Personalization).
* Design and develop API-first and event-driven integrations to enable real-time data flow, trigger-based activation, and experience orchestration across distributed systems.
* Lead the implementation of asynchronous messaging patterns using technologies like Apache Kafka or Azure Event Hub, supporting reliable, scalable event consumption and processing.
* Collaborate with DevOps and engineering teams to build and deploy resilient microservices on Microsoft Azure, leveraging Java, Quarkus, and container orchestration tools (e.g., Kubernetes, AKS).
* Translate complex MarTech business requirements into modular, reusable, and high-performance components that promote speed, stability, and scale.
* Provide hands-on technical leadership throughout the development lifecycle, including coding, configuration, observability, and CI/CD practices.
* Promote engineering best practices in documentation, security, telemetry (logs, metrics, traces), and scalability for all integration services.
* Ensure compliance with data privacy regulations (e.g., GDPR, CCPA) and implement consent-aware data handling in integration flows.
* Guide the team in applying best practices for distributed locking, retry policies and error handling for robust integration pipelines.

**Who are you:**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* 8+ years of experience in software/cloud engineering roles, preferably in MarTech, Customer Experience (CX), or Digital Transformation domains.
* Proven expertise in designing and implementing cloud-native solutions using Microsoft Azure and modern microservice architecture principles.
* Strong hands-on experience with Java, Quarkus (or equivalent frameworks like Spring Boot), and API development (REST, webhooks, OAuth2, SAML).
* Deep understanding of event-driven architecture, including real-time messaging via Kafka, Event Hub, or similar technologies.
* Experience integrating CDPs, CX, Marketing Automation, Identity and Web Personalization platforms within the MarTech ecosystem
* Familiar with data privacy and consent frameworks (e.g., GDPR, CCPA), and their impact on customer data flows.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills across cross-functional and distributed teams.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments, with a proactive mindset for innovation and continuous improvement.

**Where you'll be**

* This is a full-time position, based in Bangalore, India.

**Benefits highlights**

* Flexible work hours/hybrid work environment
* Discounts on our award-winning Electrolux products and services
* Family-friendly benefits
* Extensive learning opportunities and flexible career path.

title: Consultant
description:
**About Northern Trust**

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.

  

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.

  

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.

  
  

**Role**

**Summary:** As a member of the COO L & D Training Team, the Training Consultant will work collaboratively with team members to deliver training solutions to the assigned business unit. Under general direction the Training Consultant will assist with defining learning solutions that support the functional requirements. The Training Consultant role involves designing, developing, and delivering functional training solutions, analyzing solutions for continuous improvement and undertaking appropriate operational and administrative aspects of the training curriculum.

Principal Responsibilities

* Work with management, business process consultants and/or subject matter experts to understand desired business outcomes and translate them into learning objectives.
* Work with stakeholders to determine appropriate learning methodologies and functional training solutions.
* Handle all types of analysis.
* Develop project plans including the identification of subject matter experts where appropriate.
* Design, develop, facilitate and deliver learning programs.
* Evaluate training development programs for effectiveness and make recommendations for improvements.
* Maintain an inventory of training development programs/tools and schedules, their use according to management priorities.
* Deliver a work product that requires minimal revision.
* Serve as a key subject matter expert in program design and may mentor more junior staff.
* Acts as a product and marketing manager for training programs
* Responsible for multiple projects of various complexities
* Represent Market Operations L&D in various meetings.

**Area Specific Duties – Market Operations**

  

* Design, develop and maintain a training curriculum for the Market Operations function which can be implemented and delivered regardless of geographic location.
* Coordinate/deliver the new hire curriculum within the relevant geographic location.
* Design and deliver both self paced and instructor led training for existing systems and new system roll-outs.
* Ensure that COO learning and development interventions are aligned with the Business Unit and/or enterprise-wide needs.
* Consult with Market Operations management to provide ongoing support on training needs and business unit initiatives.
* Work collaboratively with other global training teams. Provide backup as necessary.

**Skills / Experience**

  

* Has in-depth knowledge of Market Operations and the various domains within, and strong knowledge of the business unit and corporate strategy. Has strong project management capabilities. Has excellent communication, marketing, relationship, facilitation and motivational skills. Executes efficiently and effectively.

For this position, we are looking for an individual that fits one of the two profiles below. Please note that a heavier weighting will be applied to a candidate with strong Market Operations knowledge:

**Profile 1: An experienced operations professional willing to develop their** **consulting, writing and** **presenting skills.** An experienced Market Operations/Securities Services professional who is looking to move into an L&D role

**Key requirements include:**

* **3 to 5 years experience** in Market Operations/Securities Services
* Recognised subject-matter expertise in Market Operations/Securities Services
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts clearly
* Demonstrated ability to influence and work effectively with stakeholders at all levels of the organisation
* A proactive, self-starting approach combined with a strong team mindset

**Profile 2:** **An experienced training professional willing to quickly learn all aspects of the Market Operations function**

**Requirements include:**

* **3 to 5 years experience** in training, learning consulting, or curriculum development role, ideally within financial services or a regulated environment
* Proven ability to work effectively with senior leaders, subject-matter experts, and operational teams
* A self-directed, collaborative working style
* Strong strategic perspective, with a high level of accuracy and attention to detail
* Demonstrated willingness and capability to quickly learn complex Market Operations/Securities Services processes and operating models
* Willingness and ability to give and receive feedback
* Can consult with business subject matter experts and translate SME knowledge into step by step training

All candidates will be asked to present and submit a technical writing sample, either procedures or training documentation.

**Eligibility - Internal Partners**

  

* 24 Months as a Technical Coordinator /Associate Consultant to move as a consultant
* Movement within TL and Consultant Level will be 12 months

**Working with Us**

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.

  

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.

  

**Reasonable Accommodation**

Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.

  
  

**About Our Bangalore Office**

The Northern Trust Bangalore office, established in 2005, is home to over 5,600 employees. In this stunning office space, we offer fantastic amenities which include our Arrival Hub - Jungle, the GameZone, and the Employee Experience Zone that appeal to both clients and employees. Learn more.
